title: Päd. Fachkraft für Inobhutnahmegruppe MA Käfertal (Sozialarbeiter/in / Sozialpädagoge/-pädagogin)
description: Die Zefie gGmbH wurde 2011 gegründet und verfügt mittlerweile über 5 regionale Standorte mit 15 Einrichtungen und über 130 Mitarbeitenden. Wir sind ein freier, anerkannter Jugendhilfeträger mit Angeboten in der ambulanten und stationären Jugendhilfe. Unser Ziel ist, jedes Kind und jeden Jugendlichen in seiner Entwicklung optimal und individuell zu fördern. Dafür beziehen wir nach Möglichkeit die Herkunftssysteme im Sinne des Kindeswohls mit ein.Als Verstärkung für das Team unserer Inobhutnahmegruppe „Wendepunkt“ suchen wir zum 15.12.2026 Sozialpädagog:Innen/ Psycholog:Innen/ Erzieher:Innen (m/w/d) in Voll- oder Teilzeit (ab 50%).In unserer Inobhutnahmegruppe unterstützen wir bis zu zehn männliche Jugendliche im Alter zwischen 13 und 17 Jahren im Rahmen der Inobhutnahme nach den §§ 42 und 42a SGB VIII im Auftrag des Jugendamtes der Stadt Mannheim.     Aufgaben und Anforderungen:- Sie gestalten fachlich fundiert Aufnahmeprozesse und Kriseninterventionen- Sie nehmen gemeinsam mit den Teamkollegen fachliche Einschätzungen zur individuellen Bedarfslage, den Ressourcen und Defiziten der Jugendlichen vor- Sie unterstützen die Jugendlichen und deren Familien bei der Perspektiventwicklung in enger Kooperation mit dem zuständigen Jugendamt- Gemeinsam mit den Teamkollegen und den Jugendlichen gestalten sie eine positive Gruppenatmosphäre und sinnvolle Alltagstruktur - Sie vernetzen sich mit relevanten Kooperationspartnern und Bezugspersonen für die einzelnen Jugendlichen- Sie bereiten und begleiten den Übergang der Jugendlichen in die Folgeperspektive- Sie arbeiten gerne kreativ, mit Humor und mögen es auch nach unkonventionellen Lösungen zu suchen- Sie arbeiten im Schichtdienst inklusive Übernahme von Nachtbereitschaften- Sie haben eine abgeschlossene pädagogische/ psychologische AusbildungWir bieten ihnen:- Unbefristete Festanstellung in Voll- oder Teilzeit- 30 Urlaubstage im Jahr sowie Sonderurlaubstage für Tätigkeit im Schichtdienst, sowie die Option auf Regenerationstage nach TVöD SuE- Eine vielseitige und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit der Möglichkeit eigene Interessen/Hobbies umfänglich in die Arbeit einbringen zu können, wenn es ihnen gelingt die Kinder/Jugendlichen dafür zu begeistern- Eine vertrauensvolle und partnerschaftliche Arbeitsatmosphäre- Eine Einarbeitungsphase die wir aufbauend auf ihren beruflichen Erfahrungen mit ihnen gemeinsam abstimmen- Klare Verantwortlichkeiten und kurze Entscheidungswege- Supervision- Zehn Arbeitstage im Jahr für Fort- und Weiterbildungen- Vergütung nach TVöD- Möglichkeit einer BetriebszusatzrenteUns ist wichtig:- Die Kinder/Jugendlichen sowie deren Familien professionell und individuell bestmöglich zu fördern und zu unterstützen- Unseren Mitarbeitenden Rahmenbedingungen anzubieten die es ihnen erlauben ihren beruflichen Aufträgen und Ansprüchen gerecht zu werden- Unseren Mitarbeitenden Rahmenbedingungen anzubieten die es ihnen erlauben ihre Lebensentwürfe mit den Anforderungen des Arbeitsfeldes bestmöglich zu vereinen. Natürlich unter Berücksichtigung der Bedingungen der stationären Jugendhilfe.- Dafür pflegen wir einen partnerschaftlichen Dialog der sich auch immer mit der Weiterentwicklung individueller Hilfen und konzeptioneller Ansätze auseinandersetzt- Wir schaffen Begegnungsräume im Team durch Strukturtage und Teamtage- Wir schaffen gruppenübergreifende Begegnungsmöglichkeiten bspw. durch Feste für Mitarbeitende, In-House-Schulungen oder internen Fortbildungen

title: Schulbegleitung (m/w/d) – mit oder ohne pädagogische Erfahrung oder Ausbildung (Schulbegleiter/in)
description: BITTE BEWIRB DICH DIREKT ÜBER UNSERE KARRIERESEITE, NICHT PER E-MAIL:https://karriere.begleithelden.de/o/schulbegleitung-mwd-mit-oder-ohne-padagogische-erfahrung-oder-ausbildung-8Nur so können wir deine Bewerbung vollständig erfassen und dir schnell antworten.Die Begleithelden GmbH ist ein junger und herzlicher Kita- und Schulbegleitdienst – gegründet von Menschen, die aus Überzeugung in der Eingliederungshilfe arbeiten. Wir begleiten Kinder und Jugendliche mit besonderem Unterstützungsbedarf in der Rhein-Neckar-Region, in der Pfalz sowie in den Landkreisen Bergstraße, Darmstadt-Dieburg, Alzey-Worms und Aschaffenburg. Dabei wird jedes Kind bedürfnisorientiert und einfühlsam unterstützt und in seiner Entwicklung gefördert.Für unser wachsendes Team suchen wir Menschen, denen Inklusion genauso am Herzen liegt wie uns – und die Freude daran haben, sich mit echtem Interesse auf jedes Kind einzulassen und es auf seinem eigenen Weg zu begleiten.Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir für ein Kind mit Diabetes Typ 1 eine engagierte Schulbegleitung (m/w/d) in 64372 Ober-Ramstadt an der Hans-Gustav-Röhr-Schule.Der voraussichtliche Stundenumfang beträgt 27,08 Stunden pro Woche, Montag bis Freitag von 7:45 bis 13:10 Uhr. Freitags endet der Unterricht eventuell schon um 12:30 Uhr, dann sind es 40 Minuten weniger.Darauf darfst du dich freuen- Bezahlung angelehnt an TVöD SuE mit Sonderzahlungen- Stundenlohn 17,14 bis zu 24,80 € plus zwei freiwillige Sonderzahlungen (Sommer und Weihnachtsgeld), angelehnt an TVöD SuE Stufe 1 bis 4; begleitest du mehrere Kinder, bekommst du für jedes weitere Kind einen Zuschlag auf den Stundenlohn, den wir für deinen Einsatz konkret berechnen- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge durch Entgeltumwandlung, mit unabhängiger Beratung- Betriebsärztliche Vorsorge (Angebots- und Wunschvorsorge) und kostenlose Schutzimpfungen- Familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten von Montag bis Freitag- Während der Ferienzeiten der Schule hast du frei (bitte Bundesland beachten)- Fundierte Einarbeitung über unsere Begleithelden-Akademie sowie regelmäßige Fort- und Weiterbildungen- Feste Ansprechperson im Unternehmen, die dich bei fachlichen Fragen unterstützt- Regelmäßiger Austausch mit deiner Koordination- Erste-Hilfe-Trainings- Vollständig digitale Dokumentationsprozesse- Ein kollegiales Miteinander auf Augenhöhe mit offener und ehrlicher Kommunikation- Sinnstiftende Tätigkeit, bei der du wirklich etwas bewegen kannst – deine Leistung wird gesehen und wertgeschätzt- Bei uns bist du ein wichtiger Teil eines engagierten Teams. Wir haben immer ein offenes Ohr für dich!Welche Qualifikation passt zu dir?Die Vergütung ist angelehnt an den TVöD SuE und richtet sich nach deiner Qualifikationsstufe:- QuereinsteigerIn (Nicht-Fachkraft/ angelernte Kraft): Du brauchst keine pädagogische Ausbildung. Was zählt, sind persönliche Eignung, Einfühlungsvermögen und verlässliche Kommunikation, z. B. als QuereinsteigerIn, StudentIn, ErzieherIn in Ausbildung oder mit viel Lebenserfahrung. Das nötige Rüstzeug bekommst du über unsere Begleithelden-Akademie.- QuereinsteigerIn mit Erfahrung (Nicht-Fachkraft/ angelernte Kraft): Du bringst zusätzlich Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Kindern mit, etwa aus einer Weiterbildung zur Teilhabeassistenz (Schulbegleitung, Integrationsfachkraft, InklusionsbegleiterIn) oder aus mindestens einem Jahr Tätigkeit als Begleitkraft.- SozialassistentIn oder Fachkraft mit 1-jähriger Ausbildung: auch eine gleichwertige, einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Arbeit mit Kindern und Jugendlichen zählt.- Staatlich anerkannte Fachkraft (3-jährige Ausbildung): z. B. ErzieherIn, HeilerziehungspflegerIn, (Heil-)PädagogIn, SozialpädagogIn, ArbeitserzieherIn, Pflegefachkraft, LehrerIn (mind. 1. Staatsexamen) oder PsychologIn.Stellenanforderungen- Pädagogisches Gespür und Interesse, auf die individuellen Bedürfnisse von beeinträchtigten Kindern einzugehen- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Kindern wünschenswert (keine Voraussetzung)- Eine pädagogische Ausbildung (1-jährig, z. B. als SozialassistentIn, oder 3-jährig, z. B. als ErzieherIn) ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung- Vorlage von Ausbildungsnachweisen, Abschluss- und Arbeitszeugnissen- Vorlage eines erweiterten polizeilichen Führungszeugnisses ohne Eintragungen- Masern-Immunitätsnachweis (2 Impfungen gegen Masern oder Titer-Bestimmung) für alle Personen, die nach 1970 geboren sind- Volljährigkeit- Deutsch-Kenntnisse: mindestens B2/ C1-Niveau mit Nachweis- Soft Skills: Einfühlungsvermögen, Teamfähigkeit, offene und ehrliche Kommunikation, selbständiges und zuverlässiges Arbeiten- Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen sowie zu regelmäßiger Weiterbildung und Qualitätsverbesserung- Bereitschaft zur Selbstreflexion und persönlichen WeiterentwicklungKlingt nach dir?Dann freuen wir uns sehr darauf, dich kennenzulernen!Bewirb dich bitte direkt über unsere Karriereseite: https://karriere.begleithelden.de/o/schulbegleitung-mwd-mit-oder-ohne-padagogische-erfahrung-oder-ausbildung-8Solltest du vorab Fragen haben, wende dich gerne telefonisch an:Jan-Florian Wagner: 0173 535 71 76Du bist schon Schul- oder Kitabegleitung bei einem anderen Träger? Dann sprich uns an: begleithelden.de/traeger-wechseln

title: Director Global HR (m/f/d) - Technology and Digital Transformation (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule) - Personalmanagement)

A key priority will be leading the transition from Workday to SAP SuccessFactors while establishing the longer-term digital HR roadmap. This will include AI, automation, intelligent workflows, self-service and digital adoption across the global HR function.This is your new role- Define and lead the global HR technology, digitalisation and transformation strategy, supported by a clear multi-year roadmap and governance model.- Lead the global HR technology landscape, including SAP SuccessFactors, and oversee the transition from Workday to SAP SuccessFactors.- Drive major HR technology transformation, migration, optimisation and continuous improvement programmes.- Define and embed the HR AI, automation and digital innovation strategy, ensuring responsible governance, security and privacy.- Create simple, digital-first employee and manager experiences through self-service, automation and improved HR processes.- Establish strong governance for HR systems, integrations, data quality, security, reporting and analytics.- Enable workforce insights and data-driven decision-making through effective HR reporting and analytics.- Lead global change management, adoption and capability-building across HR, including AI fluency and digital ways of working.- Partner with HR, IT, Finance, Procurement and business leaders to ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.- Build and lead a high-performing HR Technology and Digitalisation function, fostering innovation and continuous improvement.This is you:- You bring 10+ years of experience in HR Technology, Digital HR, HR Transformation or a related field within a large, complex global organisation.- You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (BSc/MSc) in Human Resources, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.- You have a proven track record of leading enterprise-scale HR technology transformations, including major implementations, migrations and platform changes.- You have strong experience with SAP SuccessFactors and/or Workday, combined with a solid understanding of HR systems, integrations and digital HR ecosystems.- You understand HR data, analytics, governance, security, privacy and compliance, and how these enable effective global HR services.- You are passionate about AI, automation and emerging technologies, with the ability to identify opportunities that improve HR efficiency and employee experience.- You can translate digital strategy into clear roadmaps, investment priorities and measurable business outcomes.- You are a strong change leader and communicator, able to influence senior HR, IT and business stakeholders across a global matrix organisation.- You combine strategic thinking with hands-on leadership, building strong teams, challenging legacy ways of working and driving digital adoption and continuous improvement.Why work for us?- lexible working arrangements designed to support a healthy work-life balance.- A permanent employment contract with a competitive salary and attractive employee benefits.- Excellent learning and career development opportunities, supported by the Nexperia Academy and dedicated talent and leadership programmes- Access to a range of additional benefits, which may include retirement provisions, mobility support, employee discounts and wellbeing initiatives, depending on location.- Access to employee assistance and wellbeing support programmes.- Opportunities to connect through social clubs, Employee Resource Groups and global initiatives.- The opportunity to work in a global technology environment, collaborating across functions and regions on strategic transformation initiatives.- A role with significant scope to shape the future of HR technology, digitalisation and AI at Nexperia.Talent acquisition based on Nexperia vacancies is not appreciated. title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description: Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.What your job includes- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes What we expect from you- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures- Autonomy in decision-making - Strong communication and presentation skills - Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficialWhat we offer youWe are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.Other benefits depending on the location

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description: To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. get in touch!We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. title: Information Security Officer (Junior)
description: JBT Marel is seeking an Information security officer (Junior).Purpose:The Information Security Officer is part of the Information Security department within JBT Marel. The Information Security department is responsible for both Risk Management and Security Operations. The Information Security Officer supports the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security framework across the business. The role acts as a security liaison between business, technology and security teams and provides practical, risk-aligned guidance within assigned areas of responsibility.It is your mission to help identify, assess and document security risks across information, processes, projects and technologies, and to support the mitigation of those risks. You know how to collaborate with stakeholders, communicate clearly, and balance security requirements with business value and usability. The Information Security Officer closely cooperates with Cyber Security Specialists and other Information Security colleagues in audits, change management, incident coordination, awareness activities, policy updates and continuous improvement initiatives. Reports to:Chief Information Security Officer. Key areas of accountability: Risk management and advisory:Identify, assess and document security risks across information processes, projects and technologies within assigned areas of responsibility.Provide constructive security advisory for inquiries related to areas of responsibility, applying established guidelines and escalating complex topics where needed.Collaborate with business stakeholders to provide clear guidance and support the development of pragmatic, risk-aligned solutions.Support mitigation planning by providing input on security risks, controls and improvement actions.Policy management:Write and update security policies, standards and procedures for assigned areas of responsibility.Contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security policies, standards and procedures.Identify gaps in policies, standards and guidelines and propose improvements to reduce security risks. Security awareness:Promote security awareness by delivering training and championing Information Security objectives.Assess current security awareness maturity in assigned areas and use insights to drive targeted improvements and clear communication.Support the adoption of the right security behavior based on JBT Marel’s policies, standards and guidelines. Reporting, audits and operations:Report on security posture and incidents within assigned areas of responsibility.Participate in technical and non-technical audits, change management processes and incident coordination activities.Apply established guidelines to analyze and resolve routine security issues.Identify opportunities for control enhancement and process improvement in assigned areas of responsibility.Support continuous improvement of the organization’s security posture and monitor advancements in Information Security best practices.Team contribution:Operate with moderate supervision and seek guidance where needed.Support onboarding or training of new team members when requested.Provide input to employee performance evaluations as needed.Competencies and Skills:     Relating and networkingPresenting and communicating informationWriting and reportingAnalytical thinkingCooperativePro-activeConceptual/forward thinkingThoroughnessStress managementPragmatic and risk-based mindsetProficient English writing and speakingLevel of Knowledge and Experience:Bachelor level in information management and auditing, IT/information security, computer sciences, or a suitable combination of formal education and experience.1 - 3 years of experience in information security, risk management, IT audit, technology governance or a related field.Basic understanding of risk management, security policy management, security awareness, incident coordination and control improvement.Knowledge of international security standards or frameworks, such as ISO 27001, IEC 62443, OWASP, CIS Controls, NIST or ISF Standard of Good Practice, is desired.Preferred: experience in working in an international/ global organization.Preferred: knowledge of the manufacturing industry and business model/processes.Why Join JBT Marel?Joining JBT Marel means becoming part of a global leader in food processing technology that is helping feed the world more sustainably. You'll collaborate with talented colleagues across multiple countries, work on strategic global initiatives, and have opportunities to develop your career in an innovative, purpose-driven organization committed to continuous improvement, customer success, and operational excellence. Interested?📧 Apply by clicking the link to access the vacancy on JBT Marel´s website: https://jbtm.wd108.myworkdayjobs.com/JBT_Marel_Career_Site/job/IS---Gardabaer/Information-Security-Officer--Junior-_25689.🌐 Learn more about us at: JBTMarel.com🔗 Follow us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/jbtmarel/Last application date is November 17, 2026. Join us - and help shape the future of maintenance excellence at JBT Marel.Use of Technology in Our Hiring ProcessJBT Marel uses technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support the review of applications.These tools help our recruiting teams identify skills and experience relevant to the role based on job-related criteria.All applications are reviewed by people, and AI is not used to make hiring decisions independently. We are committed to fair, consistent and inclusive hiring practices globally.

title: Engineering Manager
description: Fenris Creations is hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the infrastructure engineering team behind EVE Online.EVE runs as a single shared universe, where every player has an opportunity to leave a mark on a 20-year running persistent game experience. Our game cluster spans our own datacenter hardware and AWS. Our tight-knit team owns this infrastructure end-to-end: servers and network gear in the racks, the cloud networks and Golang domain specific services in AWS, and the incident, change management, testing, alerting, automation, and budget processes that keep it all running.You'll lead the engineers who build and run that platform. You'll set technical direction, own reliability and cost, and stay close enough to the work to make good calls during an outage or a hardware refresh. This is a hands-on management role.The role is based in Reykjavík, Iceland. We are a hybrid office, and offer flexibility around which days are in-office and which can be worked remotely.Your Tasks:Lead the teamHire, coach, and grow infrastructure engineers. Run 1:1s, give performance feedback, and guide career growth.Set the team's priorities across new platform work, requests from game teams, operational load, and technical debt.Run planning with product owners and other engineering leads.Own reliabilityRun the incident management process: on-call rotations and expectations, escalation paths, alerting, and blameless postmortems.Guide production change management, setting policy on deployment reviews, maintenance windows, and rollback plans, and so on.Define and track SLIs and SLOs for core services and set team priorities in response.Own the platformGuide architecture for our on-premise datacenter and AWS environments, and how traffic moves between them.Oversee hardware lifecycle: procurement, bare-metal provisioning, firmware and OS updates, and decommissioning.Own network design and security across both environments, from Cisco routers and firewalls to VPCs, Transit Gateways, and access controls.Push for automation wherever possible, in provisioning, configuration, CI/CD, and observability, to minimize engineering TOIL.Own the budgetSet the cloud and on-premise infrastructure budgets, and forecast spend as the game grows.Manage vendor relationships and contracts with cloud, datacenter, CDN, and tooling providers.Find and deliver cost savings without trading away reliability.Your Profile:Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.8+ years in infrastructure, systems, site reliability, or distributed systems engineering.2+ years managing engineers directly, including hiring and performance management.Strong grasp of distributed systems — message queues, service discovery, consistency, failure modes, and how to debug them in production.Hands-on experience running physical hardware in a datacenter — bare-metal provisioning, server and storage lifecycle, and working with colocation providers.Deep cloud provider experience, especially in networking and security (VPCs, Transit Gateways, routing, security groups) and running services at scale.Solid networking fundamentals — TCP/IP, routing protocols such as BGP, VLANs, firewalls, and router configuration.Experience leading incident response and building on-call and postmortem practices.Comfort reading and reviewing code in Golang or Python.Experience owning or forecasting an infrastructure budget.Strong technical writing and spoken communication skills in English — design docs, tradeoff analyses — and a track record of driving complex, cross-functional technical projects across multiple project and executive stakeholders.Nice to have:Experience with RabbitMQ, NATS, or other message brokers in production.Experience with DynamoDB and Redis.Automation with Python and Ansible.Bare-metal provisioning with PXE boot, Tinkerbell, or similar tools.Infrastructure as code with Terraform, and CI/CD with TeamCity or GitHub Actions.Observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or Honeycomb.Background in game services or other low-latency, high-concurrency systems.Experience with hybrid on-premise and cloud environments, or migrations between them.Our stackOur cloud platform is a set of Golang microservices in AWS, built around a service gateway and RabbitMQ message queues. On-premise, we run our own servers and Cisco network gear in the datacenter, managed with Ansible and Python.Area.Tools.Languages.Golang, Python.Messaging.RabbitMQ, NATS.Data.DynamoDB, Redis.Cloud.AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateways, EKS).Datacenter.Cisco routers, PXE boot, Ansible.Automation and CI/CD.Terraform, TeamCity.What We Can Offer You:The chance to work on EVE Online with talented, ambitious colleagues.A multicultural workplace that encourages growth and new ideas.Dual-monitor workstation and a flexible work environment.An active fun division that hosts regular events.A canteen with weekly breakfast and lunch menus, plus drinks and snacks.Discretionary quarterly and annual. performance sharing plan.Annual sports grant.Mobile phone and mobile plan.Home internet.Conditional monthly transportation grant.Free on-site doctor and other on-site. services at a discount.Relocation package.Please submit your application in English by filling in an online application here: https://careers.fenris.com/en/postings/29d70840-8361-4fc9-ac2a-de524d85fba0

title: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍK
description: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍKAre you ready to make your mark on one of Iceland’s most exciting culinary destinations?We are seeking a creative and ambitious Head Chef for a well-established fine dining restaurant in Reykjavík. Selected by the MICHELIN Guide, the restaurant offers contemporary Icelandic cuisine with strong roots in the country’s culinary heritage.This is a rare opportunity to lead a dedicated kitchen team, develop your own culinary direction and work with some of the Nordic region’s most distinctive ingredients.ABOUT THE RESTAURANTThe restaurant serves modern Icelandic cuisine, with seasonality, sustainability and local ingredients at its heart. The menus evolve with the seasons, showcasing the best Iceland has to offer—from fish, shellfish and lamb to wild herbs, seaweed and produce from local suppliers.The restaurant has recently moved to new premises with a larger, upgraded kitchen. The incoming Head Chef will have considerable creative freedom to develop the menus and help shape the restaurant’s future culinary direction.THE ROLEAs Head Chef, you will have overall responsibility for the kitchen’s culinary direction and operations. You will lead the team in its daily work, ensuring consistently exceptional standards throughout every service.Your responsibilities will include:    Leading, developing and motivating the kitchen team    Creating seasonal menus    Maintaining quality and consistency throughout every service    Establishing clear planning, structure and efficient kitchen workflows    Working closely with local, sustainably sourced ingredients    Further developing the restaurant’s identity and culinary direction    Creating a professional, safe and inclusive kitchen cultureWHO WE ARE LOOKING FORWe are looking for a creative, ambitious chef who is confident in a professional kitchen. You have a strong fine dining background and understand the precision, quality and attention to the overall guest experience expected at MICHELIN Guide level.You may already be working as a Head Chef, or you may be an outstanding Sous Chef ready to take the next step into a leadership role.We believe you bring:    Substantial experience in fine dining or another high-level culinary environment    Experience in menu development and working with seasonal ingredients    A clear, hands-on leadership style    The ability to bring structure, quality and a positive working atmosphere to the kitchen    A genuine interest in sustainability and local ingredients    The ability to balance creativity with quality, financial discipline and reliable operations    Strong communication skills in an international working environmentExperience at a Michelin restaurant or an equivalent culinary level is an advantage, but potential, leadership and ambition can be equally important.A KITCHEN WITH A STRONG TRADITION OF WOMEN IN GASTRONOMYFor the past ten years, the restaurant’s kitchen has been staffed by an all-female team. The restaurant is deeply committed to supporting women in gastronomy and creating opportunities for female chefs to develop into leaders.We want to continue building a workplace where women can grow, make an impact and take on culinary leadership roles. We welcome qualified applicants of all genders and select candidates based on their skills, leadership, motivation and potential.WHAT’S ON OFFER    A key leadership role at a restaurant recommended by the MICHELIN Guide    Considerable creative freedom to shape the menus and culinary direction    A larger, recently upgraded restaurant kitchen    Access to unique Icelandic ingredients and local producers    The opportunity to lead and develop an ambitious kitchen team    An international career opportunity in Reykjavík    Accommodation options, discussed individually    Salary, start date and other terms by agreementABOUT REYKJAVÍKReykjavík offers a rare combination of urban creativity, a vibrant restaurant scene and spectacular natural surroundings. The sea, mountains, hot springs and some of the Nordic region’s most exciting ingredients are all close at hand.For the right person, this is more than a new job. It is an opportunity to create something of your own while discovering a new country, a new food culture and a new way of life.HOW TO APPLYThe recruitment process is managed by Wildcard Untap, which helps hospitality businesses find skilled specialists and leaders through proactive search, personal dialogue and professional judgement.Please send your CV and a brief introduction outlining your experience, leadership approach and culinary philosophy to:jobb@wildcarduntap.comPlease use the subject line: “Head Chef – Reykjavík”Applications will be reviewed and interviews held on an ongoing basis. All applications will be treated confidentially.

title: HEADCHEF TILL MICHELIN GUIDE-REKOMMENDERAD RESTAURANG I REYKJAVÍK
description: Är du redo att sätta din egen prägel på en av Islands mest spännande gastronomiska destinationer?Nu söker vi en kreativ och ambitiös Head Chef till en välrenommerad fine dining-restaurang i Reykjavík. Restaurangen är utvald av MICHELIN Guide (2026) och erbjuder samtida isländsk gastronomi med tydliga rötter i landets matkultur.Det här är en sällsynt möjlighet för dig som vill leda ett engagerat köksteam, utveckla en egen kulinarisk riktning och arbeta nära några av Nordens mest särpräglade råvaror.OM RESTAURANGENRestaurangen arbetar med modern isländsk matlagning där säsong, hållbarhet och lokala råvaror står i centrum. Menyerna följer årstiderna och bygger på det bästa som Island har att erbjuda – från fisk, skaldjur och lamm till vilda örter, tång och råvaror från lokala producenter.Verksamheten har nyligen flyttat till nya lokaler med ett större och uppgraderat kök. Den nya kökschefen får därför stor kreativ frihet att utveckla menyerna och vara med och forma restaurangens framtida gastronomiska inriktning.ROLLENSom Head Chef får du det övergripande kulinariska och operativa ansvaret för köket. Du leder teamet i den dagliga driften och säkerställer att varje servering håller en jämn och mycket hög nivå.Rollen omfattar bland annat:    Ledning, utveckling och motivation av köksteamet    Utveckling av säsongsbaserade menyer    Kvalitetssäkring och konsekvent nivå i varje servering    Planering, struktur och ett effektivt arbetsflöde i köket    Nära arbete med lokala och hållbara råvaror    Att vidareutveckla restaurangens identitet och gastronomiska riktning    Att skapa en professionell, trygg och inkluderande kökskulturVEM SÖKER VI?Vi söker dig som är kreativ, ambitiös och trygg i ett professionellt kök. Du har en stark bakgrund inom fine dining och förstår de krav på precision, kvalitet och helhetsupplevelse som ställs på MICHELIN Guide-nivå.Du kan redan arbeta som Head Chef, men vi välkomnar även en mycket skicklig Sous Chef som är redo att ta nästa steg in i en ledande roll.Vi tror att du har:    Gedigen erfarenhet från fine dining eller annan gastronomisk verksamhet på hög nivå    Erfarenhet av menyutveckling och arbete med säsongsbaserade råvaror    Ett tydligt och närvarande ledarskap    Förmåga att skapa struktur, kvalitet och arbetsglädje i köket    Ett genuint intresse för hållbarhet och lokala råvaror    Förmåga att kombinera kreativitet med kvalitet, ekonomi och stabil drift    God kommunikativ förmåga i en internationell arbetsmiljöErfarenhet från en Michelin-restaurang eller motsvarande gastronomisk nivå är meriterande, men rätt potential, ledarskap och ambition kan vara lika viktigt.ETT KÖK MED EN STARK KVINNLIG TRADITIONUnder de senaste tio åren har restaurangens kök bestått av ett kvinnligt team. Verksamheten har ett starkt engagemang för att stödja kvinnor inom gastronomin och skapa möjligheter för kvinnliga kockar att utvecklas till ledare.Vi vill fortsätta bygga en arbetsplats där kvinnor kan växa, påverka och ta plats i gastronomiska ledarroller. Samtidigt välkomnar vi kvalificerade sökande oavsett kön och gör urvalet utifrån kompetens, ledarskap, motivation och potential.DET HÄR ERBJUDS    En central ledarroll på en MICHELIN Guide-rekommenderad restaurang    Stor kreativ frihet att påverka menyer och gastronomisk inriktning    Ett större och nyligen uppgraderat restaurangkök    Tillgång till unika isländska råvaror och lokala producenter    Möjlighet att leda och utveckla ett ambitiöst köksteam    En internationell karriärmöjlighet i Reykjavík    Boendemöjligheter finns och diskuteras individuellt    Lön, startdatum och övriga villkor enligt överenskommelseOM REYKJAVÍKReykjavík erbjuder en ovanlig kombination av kreativ storstad, levande restaurangkultur och storslagen natur. Här finns havet, bergen, varma källor och några av Nordens mest intressanta råvaror alldeles i närheten.För rätt person är detta mer än ett nytt arbete. Det är möjligheten att skapa något eget och samtidigt uppleva ett nytt land, en ny matkultur och en ny vardag.ANSÖKANRekryteringen genomförs av Wildcard Untap, som hjälper verksamheter inom hotell och restaurang att hitta kvalificerade specialister och ledare genom aktiv search, personlig dialog och professionellt omdöme.Skicka CV och en kort presentation av din erfarenhet, ditt ledarskap och din gastronomiska filosofi till:jobb@wildcarduntap.comMärk ansökan: ”Head Chef – Reykjavík”Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Alla ansökningar behandlas konfidentiellt.

title: Senior Raft Guide & Safety Kayaker / Kayak leiðbeinandi
description: Arctic Rafting is looking for a Senior Raft Guide and Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor for the upcoming summer season of 2027. Our season is May – September, with our high season in the summer time; June – August. There are some operations and preparations to do also before and after, in April and October. In particular, we are looking for someone to come in March, to repair equipment and do admin office work for the river operation, to prepare for the summer. This position will extend to be all year round, working part time over the winter months and taking a long leave (1-3 months). Arctic Rafting has a base camp on the well known tourist circuit of “The Golden Circle” in the southern part of Iceland, in just over an hour drive from Reykjavík capital city. Our operations include family friendly rafting trips on the mighty Hvítá River (class II-III), which is the third longest river in Iceland, originating from Langjökull Glacier. Our base camp has other amenities like a bar, restaurant, sauna and hot tubs, so clients can wind down after an action-packed adventure on the river.The qualities we are looking for is experience with good customer service, and good team work skills. Any added language skills are appreciated, operational skills for safe and high quality river trips, repairing skills for river rafting gear and other equipment, and skills for cooking, cleaning, photography, marketing/office, mechanics and general handy man skills. Job description and responsibilities of a Senior Raft Guide:* Operate safe and entertaining river tours for clients (rafting or kayaking)* Be a team leader and trip lead a group of guides in rafting trips of the size of 100+ clients* Kitchen worker and general work in the restaurant and bar serving clients* Work around the property (repair gear, cleaning, laundry, gardening and handy man jobs)Requirements:* Current WRT (Whitewater Rescue Technician) or similar* Current IRF (International Rafting Federation) certification or similar* Up to date Advanced First Aid training* Minimum 5 seasons of raft guide experience* Good English skills to communicate with clientsExtras, good to have, but not a requirement:* A big bus license to drive the river shuttle (45 seater)* Kitchen and bar experience* Photography skills* Sales / marketing skillsWork arrangements:* We generally have one morning trip and one afternoon trip every day; you either do two trips per day, or one trip and then base work for the rest of the day (cooking, cleaning, repair gear, etc.)* The work days can be anything from 4-12 hours per day, but the normality is generally 8-9 hours* A full time job means 160-170 hours per month, and as the hours vary, the pay is by hourly rates* Normally you would get 2 days off per week, but this can vary to 1-3 days off weeklyHousing and food:* Living arrangements is at an old farm in the countryside 1,5 hour from Reykjavík city, next to the river rafting base / restaurant* Everyone gets their own private room, including shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* We do daily communal dinners and everyone is expected to partake in the cooking and cleaning at the end of the day* We supply breakfast, lunch and dinner; while you are at the raft base for work Rates:* Depending on your skill level and experience the pay would be around 2.500 – 2.900isk per hour* In addition to this we offer free housing and food for your stay during your work periodPlease note that in Iceland we pay around 40% tax, and other fees will be deducted too (union, pension fund etc.)Benefits:* Some great times living in the countryside, being a raft guide for an Icelandic summer season* Private room with shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* Use of base facilities (staff kitchen, hot pots and sauna)* Occasional use of communal work car; we strongly recommend having a valid driver’s license, as public transport in Iceland is quite horrid when you live at an old farm in the middle of nowhere.About the Company:This is one of the oldest adventure activities to do in Iceland, but the first river rafting trip with clients was made here in 1985. Around 1990 they started renovations at the old barn and farm house to make the raft base into what it is today; changing rooms, showers, sauna, hot pots, restaurant, bar and guide facilities; for around 10-12 staff members to live there for the summer season. Our clients are mostly from Iceland, Europe and USA, so the minimal language requirements are good English skills. Owned by a local raft guide and kayaker, and more details can be found on our website: www.arcticrafting.com This video sums up what a normal day in the summer looks like – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQTo apply; please send a CV and cover letter to drumbo@arcticrafting.is before 1st of December 2026Best regards,The Arctic Rafting teamdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.comArctic Rafting leitar að reyndum flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanni (Senior Raft Guide) og öryggiskajakræðara/kajakkennara (Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor) fyrir komandi sumartímabil árið 2027.Starfstímabilið okkar er frá maí til september, en háannatíminn er yfir sumarmánuðina, júní til ágúst. Einnig þarf að sinna ýmsum undirbúnings- og rekstrarverkefnum fyrir og eftir tímabilið, í apríl og október.Við leitum sérstaklega að einstaklingi sem getur hafið störf í mars til að sinna viðgerðum á búnaði og skrifstofu- og stjórnsýsluverkefnum tengdum flúðasiglingarekstrinum, til undirbúnings fyrir sumarið.Starfið mun þróast yfir í heilsársstarf, þar sem unnið verður í hlutastarfi yfir vetrarmánuðina og möguleiki verður á lengra leyfi, í 1–3 mánuði.StarfsumhverfiðArctic Rafting er með bækistöð við hina þekktu ferðamannaleið Gullna hringinn á Suðurlandi, í rúmlega klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík.Starfsemin felur meðal annars í sér fjölskylduvænar flúðasiglingaferðir á hinni mikilfenglegu Hvítá (erfiðleikaflokkur II–III). Hvítá er þriðja lengsta á Íslands og á upptök sín við Langjökul.Á bækistöðinni er einnig bar, veitingastaður, gufubað og heitir pottar þar sem gestir geta slakað á eftir ævintýralega ferð niður ána.Eiginleikar sem við leitum aðVið leitum að einstaklingi sem hefur reynslu af góðri þjónustu við viðskiptavini og býr yfir góðri hæfni í teymisvinnu.Önnur tungumálakunnátta er kostur, sem og færni í að skipuleggja og framkvæma öruggar og vandaðar flúðasiglingaferðir.Einnig er kostur að hafa reynslu af viðgerðum á flúðasiglingabúnaði og öðrum tækjum, matreiðslu, þrifum, ljósmyndun, markaðssetningu, skrifstofustörfum, vélaviðgerðum og almennum viðhaldsverkefnum.Starfslýsing og ábyrgð yfirleiðsögumannsStjórna öruggum og skemmtilegum flúðasiglinga- og kajakferðum fyrir viðskiptavini.Vera leiðtogi teymis og stýra hópi leiðsögumanna í flúðasiglingaferðum með yfir 100 þátttakendum.Vinna í eldhúsi og sinna almennum störfum á veitingastað og bar, þar á meðal þjónustu við gesti.Sinna ýmsum verkefnum á svæðinu, svo sem viðgerðum á búnaði, þrifum, þvotti, garðvinnu og almennu viðhaldi.HæfniskröfurGilt WRT-skírteini (Whitewater Rescue Technician – sérhæfð björgun í straumvatni) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild IRF-réttindi (International Rafting Federation – Alþjóðasamband flúðasiglinga) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild og uppfærð réttindi í ítarlegri skyndihjálp (Advanced First Aid).Að lágmarki fimm tímabils reynsla sem flúðasiglingaleiðsögumaður.Góð enskukunnátta til að eiga samskipti við viðskiptavini.Viðbótarhæfni sem er kostur en ekki skilyrðiÖkuréttindi til að aka stórri rútu (45 farþega) sem notuð er til að flytja gesti til og frá ánni.Reynsla af eldhús- og barstörfum.Hæfni í ljósmyndun.Reynsla af sölu- og markaðsmálum.Vinnutími og starfskjörYfirleitt eru farnar tvær flúðasiglingaferðir á dag, ein að morgni og önnur síðdegis.Starfsmaður fer annaðhvort í tvær ferðir á dag eða eina ferð og sinnir síðan öðrum verkefnum á bækistöðinni, svo sem matreiðslu, þrifum eða viðgerðum á búnaði.Vinnudagar geta verið allt frá 4 upp í 12 klukkustundir, en algengast er að þeir séu um 8–9 klukkustundir.Fullt starf miðast við 160–170 vinnustundir á mánuði. Þar sem vinnustundir eru breytilegar eru laun greidd samkvæmt tímakaupi.Yfirleitt eru tveir frídagar í viku, en þeir geta verið frá einum upp í þrjá eftir aðstæðum.Húsnæði og fæðiStarfsfólk býr á gömlum sveitabæ í um 1,5 klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík, við hliðina á flúðasiglingabækistöðinni og veitingastaðnum.Allir starfsmenn fá sérherbergi en deila sameiginlegri aðstöðu, þar á meðal baðherbergi með sturtu.Sameiginlegur kvöldverður er á hverjum degi og ætlast er til að allir taki þátt í matreiðslu og frágangi í lok dags.Boðið er upp á morgunmat, hádegismat og kvöldmat á meðan starfsfólk er við vinnu á bækistöðinni.LaunTímakaup fer eftir hæfni og reynslu viðkomandi og er á bilinu 2.500–2.900 krónur á klukkustund.Auk launa er boðið upp á ókeypis húsnæði og fæði meðan á starfstímabilinu stendur.Athugið að á Íslandi geta skattar numið um 40% af launum og að önnur gjöld eru einnig dregin frá, svo sem stéttarfélagsgjöld og lífeyrissjóðsiðgjöld.FríðindiEinstakt tækifæri til að upplifa íslenskt sumar í sveitinni og starfa við flúðasiglingar.Sérherbergi með sameiginlegri baðaðstöðu.Aðgangur að aðstöðu á bækistöðinni, þar á meðal starfsmannaeldhúsi, heitum pottum og gufubaði.Stundum er hægt að nýta sameiginlegan starfsmannabíl.Við mælum eindregið með því að umsækjendur hafi gilt ökuskírteini, þar sem almenningssamgöngur á Íslandi eru afar takmarkaðar þegar búið er á gömlum sveitabæ úti í sveit.Um fyrirtækiðFlúðasiglingar eru ein elsta skipulagða ævintýraafþreying sem boðið hefur verið upp á á Íslandi. Fyrsta flúðasiglingaferðin með viðskiptavini á þessu svæði var farin árið 1985.Um 1990 hófst endurnýjun á gamla fjósinu og íbúðarhúsinu á bænum með það að markmiði að útbúa þá aðstöðu sem þar er í dag.Þar er nú að finna búningsklefa, sturtur, gufubað, heita potta, veitingastað, bar og aðstöðu fyrir leiðsögumenn. Á sumrin er aðstaða fyrir um 10–12 starfsmenn til að búa á staðnum.Viðskiptavinir okkar koma að mestu leyti frá Íslandi, Evrópu og Bandaríkjunum og því er góð enskukunnátta lágmarkskrafa.Fyrirtækið er í eigu flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanns og kajakræðara úr heimabyggð.Nánari upplýsingar um fyrirtækið má finna á vefsíðunni:www.arcticrafting.comMyndband sem sýnir dæmigerðan sumardag hjá Arctic Rafting:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQUmsóknir:Áhugasamir eru beðnir um að senda ferilskrá og kynningarbréf á netfangið:drumbo@arcticrafting.isUmsóknarfrestur er til 1. desember 2026.Með bestu kveðju,Starfsfólk Arctic Raftingdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.com

title: Information Security Officer (Junior)
description: JBT Marel is seeking an Information security officer (Junior).Purpose:The Information Security Officer is part of the Information Security department within JBT Marel. The Information Security department is responsible for both Risk Management and Security Operations. The Information Security Officer supports the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security framework across the business. The role acts as a security liaison between business, technology and security teams and provides practical, risk-aligned guidance within assigned areas of responsibility.It is your mission to help identify, assess and document security risks across information, processes, projects and technologies, and to support the mitigation of those risks. You know how to collaborate with stakeholders, communicate clearly, and balance security requirements with business value and usability. The Information Security Officer closely cooperates with Cyber Security Specialists and other Information Security colleagues in audits, change management, incident coordination, awareness activities, policy updates and continuous improvement initiatives. Key areas of accountability: Risk management and advisory:Identify, assess and document security risks across information processes, projects and technologies within assigned areas of responsibility.Provide constructive security advisory for inquiries related to areas of responsibility, applying established guidelines and escalating complex topics where needed.Collaborate with business stakeholders to provide clear guidance and support the development of pragmatic, risk-aligned solutions.Support mitigation planning by providing input on security risks, controls and improvement actions.Policy management:Write and update security policies, standards and procedures for assigned areas of responsibility.Contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security policies, standards and procedures.Identify gaps in policies, standards and guidelines and propose improvements to reduce security risks. Security awareness:Promote security awareness by delivering training and championing Information Security objectives.Assess current security awareness maturity in assigned areas and use insights to drive targeted improvements and clear communication.Support the adoption of the right security behavior based on JBT Marel’s policies, standards and guidelines. Reporting, audits and operations:Report on security posture and incidents within assigned areas of responsibility.Participate in technical and non-technical audits, change management processes and incident coordination activities.Apply established guidelines to analyze and resolve routine security issues.Identify opportunities for control enhancement and process improvement in assigned areas of responsibility.Support continuous improvement of the organization’s security posture and monitor advancements in Information Security best practices.Team contribution:Operate with moderate supervision and seek guidance where needed.Support onboarding or training of new team members when requested.Provide input to employee performance evaluations as needed.Competencies and Skills:     Relating and networkingPresenting and communicating informationWriting and reportingAnalytical thinkingCooperativePro-activeConceptual/forward thinkingThoroughnessStress managementPragmatic and risk-based mindsetProficient English writing and speakingLevel of Knowledge and Experience:Bachelor level in information management and auditing, IT/information security, computer sciences, or a suitable combination of formal education and experience.1 - 3 years of experience in information security, risk management, IT audit, technology governance or a related field.Basic understanding of risk management, security policy management, security awareness, incident coordination and control improvement.Knowledge of international security standards or frameworks, such as ISO 27001, IEC 62443, OWASP, CIS Controls, NIST or ISF Standard of Good Practice, is desired.Preferred: experience in working in an international/ global organization.Preferred: knowledge of the manufacturing industry and business model/processes.Why Join JBT Marel?Joining JBT Marel means becoming part of a global leader in food processing technology that is helping feed the world more sustainably. You'll collaborate with talented colleagues across multiple countries, work on strategic global initiatives, and have opportunities to develop your career in an innovative, purpose-driven organization committed to continuous improvement, customer success, and operational excellence. title: Engineering Manager
description: Fenris Creations is hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the infrastructure engineering team behind EVE Online.EVE runs as a single shared universe, where every player has an opportunity to leave a mark on a 20-year running persistent game experience. Our game cluster spans our own datacenter hardware and AWS. Our tight-knit team owns this infrastructure end-to-end: servers and network gear in the racks, the cloud networks and Golang domain specific services in AWS, and the incident, change management, testing, alerting, automation, and budget processes that keep it all running.You'll lead the engineers who build and run that platform. You'll set technical direction, own reliability and cost, and stay close enough to the work to make good calls during an outage or a hardware refresh. This is a hands-on management role.The role is based in Reykjavík, Iceland. We are a hybrid office, and offer flexibility around which days are in-office and which can be worked remotely.Your Tasks:Lead the teamHire, coach, and grow infrastructure engineers. Run 1:1s, give performance feedback, and guide career growth.Set the team's priorities across new platform work, requests from game teams, operational load, and technical debt.Run planning with product owners and other engineering leads.Own reliabilityRun the incident management process: on-call rotations and expectations, escalation paths, alerting, and blameless postmortems.Guide production change management, setting policy on deployment reviews, maintenance windows, and rollback plans, and so on.Define and track SLIs and SLOs for core services and set team priorities in response.Own the platformGuide architecture for our on-premise datacenter and AWS environments, and how traffic moves between them.Oversee hardware lifecycle: procurement, bare-metal provisioning, firmware and OS updates, and decommissioning.Own network design and security across both environments, from Cisco routers and firewalls to VPCs, Transit Gateways, and access controls.Push for automation wherever possible, in provisioning, configuration, CI/CD, and observability, to minimize engineering TOIL.Own the budgetSet the cloud and on-premise infrastructure budgets, and forecast spend as the game grows.Manage vendor relationships and contracts with cloud, datacenter, CDN, and tooling providers.Find and deliver cost savings without trading away reliability.Your Profile:Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.8+ years in infrastructure, systems, site reliability, or distributed systems engineering.2+ years managing engineers directly, including hiring and performance management.Strong grasp of distributed systems — message queues, service discovery, consistency, failure modes, and how to debug them in production.Hands-on experience running physical hardware in a datacenter — bare-metal provisioning, server and storage lifecycle, and working with colocation providers.Deep cloud provider experience, especially in networking and security (VPCs, Transit Gateways, routing, security groups) and running services at scale.Solid networking fundamentals — TCP/IP, routing protocols such as BGP, VLANs, firewalls, and router configuration.Experience leading incident response and building on-call and postmortem practices.Comfort reading and reviewing code in Golang or Python.Experience owning or forecasting an infrastructure budget.Strong technical writing and spoken communication skills in English — design docs, tradeoff analyses — and a track record of driving complex, cross-functional technical projects across multiple project and executive stakeholders.Nice to have:Experience with RabbitMQ, NATS, or other message brokers in production.Experience with DynamoDB and Redis.Automation with Python and Ansible.Bare-metal provisioning with PXE boot, Tinkerbell, or similar tools.Infrastructure as code with Terraform, and CI/CD with TeamCity or GitHub Actions.Observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or Honeycomb.Background in game services or other low-latency, high-concurrency systems.Experience with hybrid on-premise and cloud environments, or migrations between them.Our stackOur cloud platform is a set of Golang microservices in AWS, built around a service gateway and RabbitMQ message queues. On-premise, we run our own servers and Cisco network gear in the datacenter, managed with Ansible and Python.Area.Tools.Languages.Golang, Python.Messaging.RabbitMQ, NATS.Data.DynamoDB, Redis.Cloud.AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateways, EKS).Datacenter.Cisco routers, PXE boot, Ansible.Automation and CI/CD.Terraform, TeamCity.What We Can Offer You:The chance to work on EVE Online with talented, ambitious colleagues.A multicultural workplace that encourages growth and new ideas.Dual-monitor workstation and a flexible work environment.An active fun division that hosts regular events.A canteen with weekly breakfast and lunch menus, plus drinks and snacks.Discretionary quarterly and annual. performance sharing plan.Annual sports grant.Mobile phone and mobile plan.Home internet.Conditional monthly transportation grant.Free on-site doctor and other on-site. services at a discount.Relocation package.Please submit your application in English by filling in an online application here: https://careers.fenris.com/en/postings/29d70840-8361-4fc9-ac2a-de524d85fba0

title: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍK
description: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍKAre you ready to make your mark on one of Iceland’s most exciting culinary destinations?We are seeking a creative and ambitious Head Chef for a well-established fine dining restaurant in Reykjavík. Selected by the MICHELIN Guide, the restaurant offers contemporary Icelandic cuisine with strong roots in the country’s culinary heritage.This is a rare opportunity to lead a dedicated kitchen team, develop your own culinary direction and work with some of the Nordic region’s most distinctive ingredients.ABOUT THE RESTAURANTThe restaurant serves modern Icelandic cuisine, with seasonality, sustainability and local ingredients at its heart. The menus evolve with the seasons, showcasing the best Iceland has to offer—from fish, shellfish and lamb to wild herbs, seaweed and produce from local suppliers.The restaurant has recently moved to new premises with a larger, upgraded kitchen. The incoming Head Chef will have considerable creative freedom to develop the menus and help shape the restaurant’s future culinary direction.THE ROLEAs Head Chef, you will have overall responsibility for the kitchen’s culinary direction and operations. You will lead the team in its daily work, ensuring consistently exceptional standards throughout every service.Your responsibilities will include:    Leading, developing and motivating the kitchen team    Creating seasonal menus    Maintaining quality and consistency throughout every service    Establishing clear planning, structure and efficient kitchen workflows    Working closely with local, sustainably sourced ingredients    Further developing the restaurant’s identity and culinary direction    Creating a professional, safe and inclusive kitchen cultureWHO WE ARE LOOKING FORWe are looking for a creative, ambitious chef who is confident in a professional kitchen. You have a strong fine dining background and understand the precision, quality and attention to the overall guest experience expected at MICHELIN Guide level.You may already be working as a Head Chef, or you may be an outstanding Sous Chef ready to take the next step into a leadership role.We believe you bring:    Substantial experience in fine dining or another high-level culinary environment    Experience in menu development and working with seasonal ingredients    A clear, hands-on leadership style    The ability to bring structure, quality and a positive working atmosphere to the kitchen    A genuine interest in sustainability and local ingredients    The ability to balance creativity with quality, financial discipline and reliable operations    Strong communication skills in an international working environmentExperience at a Michelin restaurant or an equivalent culinary level is an advantage, but potential, leadership and ambition can be equally important.A KITCHEN WITH A STRONG TRADITION OF WOMEN IN GASTRONOMYFor the past ten years, the restaurant’s kitchen has been staffed by an all-female team. The restaurant is deeply committed to supporting women in gastronomy and creating opportunities for female chefs to develop into leaders.We want to continue building a workplace where women can grow, make an impact and take on culinary leadership roles. We welcome qualified applicants of all genders and select candidates based on their skills, leadership, motivation and potential.WHAT’S ON OFFER    A key leadership role at a restaurant recommended by the MICHELIN Guide    Considerable creative freedom to shape the menus and culinary direction    A larger, recently upgraded restaurant kitchen    Access to unique Icelandic ingredients and local producers    The opportunity to lead and develop an ambitious kitchen team    An international career opportunity in Reykjavík    Accommodation options, discussed individually    Salary, start date and other terms by agreementABOUT REYKJAVÍKReykjavík offers a rare combination of urban creativity, a vibrant restaurant scene and spectacular natural surroundings. The sea, mountains, hot springs and some of the Nordic region’s most exciting ingredients are all close at hand.For the right person, this is more than a new job. It is an opportunity to create something of your own while discovering a new country, a new food culture and a new way of life.HOW TO APPLYThe recruitment process is managed by Wildcard Untap, which helps hospitality businesses find skilled specialists and leaders through proactive search, personal dialogue and professional judgement.Please send your CV and a brief introduction outlining your experience, leadership approach and culinary philosophy to:jobb@wildcarduntap.comPlease use the subject line: “Head Chef – Reykjavík”Applications will be reviewed and interviews held on an ongoing basis. All applications will be treated confidentially.

title: Community Employment Supervisor
description: Make a difference. Support people. Build opportunities.Monaghan Group of Parishes is seeking to recruit an experienced, motivated and committed Community Employment (CE) Supervisor to manage and coordinate the day-to-day operation of its Community Employment Scheme.This is an exciting opportunity for an individual with strong organisational, administrative and people-management skills who is passionate about supporting individuals participant supervision, financial administration, training and development, programme compliance and employment progression.Key ResponsibilitiesScheme Management and Administration•    Manage the operates in accordance with CE procedures and programme requirements.•    Maintain appropriate financial, training, attendance and programme records.•    Promote a safe and healthy working environment.•    Submit monthly reports -to the Sponsoring Management Committee.Essential RequirementsCandidates must demonstrate:•    Relevant supervisory and people-management experience.•    Experience in administration, project management, training or a related field.•    A solid understanding of supervision, programme delivery and organisational management.•    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.•    Competent report-writing and administrative skills.•    Experience working with vulnerable individuals, jobseekers or people facing barriers to employment.•    The ability to direct, motivate, coach and mentor individuals.•    Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office.•    A recognised NFQ Level 6 Major Award or higher, preferably in Business, Financial Administration, Supervisory management, Training, Human Resources, Project Management or a related discipline.The Ideal CandidateThe successful candidate will be:•    Highly organised, proactive and self-motivated.•    A confident and supportive people manager.•    An effective communicator with strong interpersonal skills.•    Capable of managing competing priorities and working to deadlines.•    Committed to participant development and progression.•    Able to work collaboratively with the Sponsoring Organisation, participants, employers and external agencies.

title: Venue Operations and Client Support Co-Ordinator
description: Venue Operations and Client Support Co-OrdinatorAgTechUCD Innovation Centre, UCD Lyons FarmPosition type    Full-time Fixed Term for 24 monthsLocation    AgTechUCD Innovation Centre, UCD Lyons Research Farm, Celbridge, Co KildareReports to    Director of Innovation UCDSalary    €60,000 per year Hours    37 hours Full-time, with occasional evening and weekend eventsAbout AgTechUCDAgTechUCD is University College Dublin’s innovation centre for early-stage start-ups and SMEs working in agri, agtech, agrifood and veterinary sectors. Part of NovaUCD, it builds on NovaUCD’s track record of supporting high-tech start-ups. It is a collaboration between UCD and a network of industry, investor and research partners.AgTechUCD is a collaboration between NovaUCD, Kildare County Council, and Kildare LEO and is funded by the Regional Enterprise Development Fund. It also includes support from agri-companies such as; Devenish, Dairymaster, and Glanbia; investors such as; The Yield Lab, and Atlantic Bridge, along with leading AgTech researchers and innovators at UCD, Teagasc and Wageningen University and Research, Netherlands.  The AgTech Innovation Centre is based at UCD Lyons Farm, the University’s research and teaching farm. The building (about 890 sq.m.) offers flexible lab spaces, meeting rooms, offices and an exhibition space, and sits alongside the UCD Bimeda Herd Health Hub. It is home to a growing community of resident companies and is also available as a venue for events, workshops and industry gatherings.The RoleWe are looking for an energetic, organised and practical Venue Operations and Client Support Co-Ordinator to run the building day to day and to grow its profile as a venue for events and home for AgTech Start Up companies.This is primarily an operations role, with a meaningful commercial side. You will spend roughly 60% of your time on operations (building, events delivery and resident support and financial management and reporting) and 40% on marketing and sales (promoting the venue, winning event bookings and building relationships). An important part of the role is attracting clients to take up space in the incubator be it office or lab space and also selling the exhibition area and meeting rooms as an important event space.  A key requirement of the role is to attract business to the incubator and ensure it is an attractive area for prospective clients.  You will be the first point of contact for our resident companies and for everyone who hires or visits the space.Flexibility is required in this role (in working hours and tasks) and excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as a willingness to travel as needed and a full driving licence will all be essential for this positionKey Responsibilities1. Building and Facilities Operations•    Oversee the daily running of the building, including access control, opening and closing procedures and building security.•    Act as the main point of contact for maintenance and building services and out-of-hours contacts. Manage relationships with contractors and service providers (for example HVAC, plumbing, electrical, IT and broadband), log and prioritise issues, and make sure repairs are completed promptly. Technical repairs are carried out by qualified contractors; you coordinate and follow up.•    Carry out regular building walk-throughs to keep the centre clean, organised and safe, and to meet Health and Safety requirements, including the specific requirements of a lab and farm-campus environment.•    Liaise with UCD campus services and Lyons Farm colleagues on shared infrastructure, site access and safety procedures.•    Manage inventory and ordering for kitchen supplies, office consumables and event equipment.2. Event Coordination and Delivery•    Act as the primary contact for internal and external event hosts, from first enquiry through to delivery and follow-up.•    Prepare event spaces before bookings and reset them promptly afterwards, including room layouts and equipment setup.•    Provide on-the-ground support during events, including A/V and lighting setup, layout changes and immediate troubleshooting.•    Coordinate third-party suppliers such as caterers, equipment hire companies and cleaners.•    Gather feedback after events and use it to improve the venue offering.3. Resident Company Support and Community•    Be the day-to-day go-to person for resident start-ups and SMEs, creating a welcoming, collaborative and energetic atmosphere.•    Manage onboarding and offboarding of resident companies, including induction, access, desk and lab space allocation and handover.•    Organise community activities that add value for residents, such as networking sessions, coffee mornings, skill-sharing sessions and visits from investors, industry partners and researchers.•    Work closely with the AgTechUCD and NovaUCD teams to support accelerator programme activity and events hosted in the building.4. Venue Marketing and Event Sales•    Promote the venue to corporate clients, agri-food and agtech networks, industry bodies, community groups and external event organisers, with the aim of growing event booking revenue.•    Develop and run marketing activity for the venue, including social media content, creative materials, newsletters and direct outreach.•    Conduct site tours for prospective clients, presenting the layout options, technical capability and amenities of the building.•    Create and maintain attractive event packages covering room layouts, technical setup and catering partnerships, with clear pricing.•    Manage the enquiry-to-booking process, track leads and bookings, and report regularly on occupancy and revenue.•    Build relationships with local and sector networks in the agri-food, agtech and university communities to raise the profile of the building as a destination for events.5. Financial Management/Governance and Reporting•    Report to various stakeholders both internal and external including the UCD Director of Innovation and the UCD Nova DAC board•    Process RFQs, tenders , raise requisitions and close out the purchasing process adhering to UCDs procurement process.•    Create and issue Client/Customer monthly invoices and manage and report on De Minimus passthrough.Essential Skills and Experience•    2 to 4 years’ experience in venue management, events coordination, hospitality, co-working or innovation-space operations, or a similar customer-facing role.•    Proven ability to manage a building or venue in practice: coordinating contractors, solving problems quickly and keeping standards high.•    Experience promoting a venue, service or brand through social media, networking and direct outreach, and converting enquiries into bookings.•    A friendly, confident and professional manner, with the ability to build strong relationships with start-up founders, clients and suppliers.•    Strong organisational skills and a hands-on, “no task too small” attitude. You are comfortable dealing with a facilities issue in the morning and pitching to a client in the afternoon.•    Comfort with workplace technology: A/V equipment, access control and booking systems, and social media tools, or a willingness to learn them quickly.•    A practical, hands-on approach to setting up rooms and equipment for events.•    Financial management, including budgeting, and reporting experience is required.•    Flexibility to work occasional evenings and weekends for events.•    Experience working as part of a team and ability to direct staff and contractors•    Full driving licence Desirable•    Experience working in a university, innovation centre, incubator or co-working environment.•    Knowledge of, or interest in, the agri-food, agtech or veterinary sectors.•    Health and Safety or manual handling qualification, or first aid training.•    Experience of using a CRM or booking platform to manage leads and enquiries.What We Offer•    A salary of €60,000 per year.•    The chance to work directly alongside high-growth agtech and agri-food companies and the wider NovaUCD innovation community.•    Training in relevant Health and Safety areas, including manual handling, and support for further professional development.•    Variety in work with a large part of the time spent in the AgTechUCD Innovation Centre but with the opportunity to network and travel to attract clients to the centre and to work with colleagues on UCD’s other campuses•    Working as part of a wider NovaUCD team•    37 hour week with 27 days annual leave.•    Auto description: As a Civil Engineer Intern, you will support multidisciplinary teams delivering water and wastewater projects in office and site environments while building practical skills across project delivery, quality, safety and sustainability. Quality Safety and Sustainability Promote and follow Glanua's health, safety, environmental, quality and sustainability standards, policies and procedures. Learning Collaboration and Development Build familiarity with BIM, Revit and drafting tools and develop an understanding of how digital information supports project delivery. Learn about water and wastewater treatment processes, including potential exposure to modular package treatment plant fabrication. Communicate clearly with colleagues and contribute positively to multidisciplinary project and site teams. Take part in mentoring, continuous learning and feedback.

description: Per una realtà italiana di primo piano nel settore dei servizi sanitari e della diagnostica, impegnata a offrire alle persone un percorso di cura integrato e di qualità, ricerchiamo un/una Senior Cybersecurity Specialist. La figura entrerà a far parte della Direzione ICT e avrà la responsabilità di supervisionare e rafforzare la sicurezza informatica aziendale, contribuendo alla protezione di infrastrutture, sistemi e dati. Principali responsabilità Gestire sistemi, servizi e prodotti di cybersecurity e collaborare con le funzioni ICT per definire configurazioni sicure di apparati, servizi, sistemi e soluzioni. Applicare le procedure aziendali in materia di Qualità, Privacy e Compliance, segnalando tempestivamente eventuali scostamenti o irregolarità alle funzioni competenti. Progettare, implementare, verificare e documentare policy e procedure per proteggere l'infrastruttura informatica da minacce e violazioni della sicurezza. Implementare processi interni ed esterni di Vulnerability Assessment e monitorare l'efficacia dei controlli adottati. Individuare le vulnerabilità e coordinare le opportune azioni di remediation, tutelando la sicurezza della rete e dei dati. Sviluppare e attuare un piano almeno triennale per la messa in sicurezza dei sistemi informativi aziendali. Monitorare l'utilizzo dei sistemi ICT per verificarne la conformità alle policy di sicurezza. Mantenersi aggiornato/a sugli standard di sicurezza IT e sull'evoluzione delle minacce. Documentare le violazioni di sicurezza, valutarne gli impatti e sottoporre le evidenze agli organi competenti. Promuovere presso i colleghi dei Sistemi Informativi le migliori pratiche per la protezione delle informazioni. Organizzare il supporto del service desk per le tematiche di cybersecurity. Predisporre report periodici sullo stato della sicurezza aziendale per la Direzione ICT e il Board. Requisiti ed esperienza Esperienza di almeno 6-7 anni in ambito cybersecurity, maturata nella gestione tecnica di sistemi, servizi e soluzioni di sicurezza. Conoscenza approfondita di sistemi, servizi e prodotti di cybersecurity. Capacità di integrare e automatizzare soluzioni di sicurezza. Esperienza nella gestione tecnica di sistemi di cybersecurity, tra cui Identity Management, sicurezza e configurazione di rete, sistemi di monitoraggio, firewall e reverse proxy. Conoscenza delle principali normative e degli standard di settore, tra cui NIS2, GDPR, MDR, NIST e ISO. Capacità di collaborare efficacemente con team IT/OT e con le diverse funzioni aziendali. Missione del ruolo La risorsa si occuperà, in base al livello di autonomia e competenze maturate, di diagnosi, ricerca guasti, manutenzione, riparazione e collaudo dei veicoli, intervenendo su sistemi meccanici, elettrici ed elettronici, incluse le vetture elettrificate e BEV. Cosa farai Eseguirai attività di diagnosi strutturata e ricerca guasti, individuando la causa primaria delle anomalie e definendo gli interventi correttivi necessari. Effettuerai interventi di manutenzione ordinaria e straordinaria, riparazione e sostituzione componenti su tutta la gamma. Opererai su veicoli elettrificati/BEV e, se in possesso delle qualifiche, su sistemi ad alta tensione, nel rispetto delle procedure di sicurezza. Eseguirai controlli, misurazioni, regolazioni, programmazioni e verifiche funzionali post-intervento (incluse prove su strada dove previste). Documenterai in modo accurato diagnosi e attività svolte, garantendo tracciabilità e fornendo indicazioni tecniche chiare all'Accettazione. Collaborerai con Magazzino Ricambi per identificazione e disponibilità componenti e supporterai, per quanto di competenza, la gestione pratiche garanzia. Lavorerai in sinergia con il team e parteciperai a programmi di formazione/aggiornamento per restare allineato all'evoluzione tecnologica (elettrificazione, elettronica, diagnostica, sistemi digitali). Esperienza significativa nel settore automotive in ruoli di tecnico meccanico/meccatronico/diagnostico/officina. Solida conoscenza dei sistemi meccanici, elettrici ed elettronici del veicolo. Buona capacità di diagnosi e ricerca guasti con strumentazione. Conoscenza dei principi di funzionamento di tecnologie elettrificate e BEV (batterie, ricarica, alta tensione); qualifiche specifiche HV preferenziali. Buona familiarità con strumenti informatici e diagnostici automotive. Capacità di consultare e applicare documentazione e procedure tecniche. Patente B.
