Eligibility is subject to local regulations.​ Are you ready for an exciting new challenge? Does the above description sound like you? Welcome to apply!  Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don’t delay – apply today! Hiring Manager Gun Norling, gun.norling@hitachienergy.com will answer your questions about the position.  All other questions should be directed to Talent Partner Julia Wiklund, Julia.wiklund1@hitachienergy.com Union representatives - Sveriges Ingenjörer: Mikael Hjort, +46 107-38 29 86; Unionen: Fredrik Holmgren, +46 107-38 21 85; Ledarna: Frank Hollstedt, +46 107-38 70 43.

title: Socialsekreterare Vuxenenheten
description: Välkommen till Lidköping! Du letar efter nya utmaningar. Vi letar efter dig! Vi hoppas att du vill vara en del av en välkomnande och hållbar kommun som drivs av engagemang. I Lidköping finns vattnet alltid nära med Vänern och skärgården runt hörnet och Lidan som ringlar fram genom staden. Det är en plats rik på historia som vi omfamnar när vi har siktet inställt på att utveckla och planera för framtidens Lidköping. Hos oss får du möjlighet att testa nytt och utvecklas samtidigt som du dagligen gör skillnad för invånare, företagare, föreningar och besökare i Lidköping. Välkommen med din ansökan till Lidköpings kommun!Varmt välkommen till Lidköping – en hållbar och välkomnande kommun!Om jobbetEn av våra kollegor kommer att gå i pension och vi söker därför dig som vill arbeta som socialsekreterare hos oss på Vuxenenheten med myndighetsutövning gällande ärenden med skadligt bruk och beroende. Du kommer att tillhöra Vuxenenheten som leds av en enhetschef. På Vuxenenheten arbetar socialsekreterare med ärenden inom skadligt bruk och beroende och/eller våld i nära relation och LSS-handläggare som arbetar med ärenden inom SoL/LSS-lagstiftningen. Till Vuxenenheten hör också Rådgivningscentrum som är Vuxenenhetens öppenvård riktat gentemot skadligt bruk och beroende, våld i nära relation och stöd till anhöriga. På Rådgivningscentrum arbetar samordnare, alkohol- och drogterapeuter och kuratorer.  ArbetsuppgifterTjänsten innebär främst kvalificerat utredningsarbete och uppföljning av beslutade insatser gällande skadligt bruk och beroende enligt SoL och LVM. Arbete kan också förekomma gällande myndighetsutövning våld i nära relation.Ditt arbete är förändringsinriktat och du kommer att utgöra en nyckelroll i arbetet med att tillsammans med klienten skapa förutsättningar för ett socialt fungerande liv. Du kommer att arbeta med myndighetsutövning tillsammans med kollegor i en stabil arbetsgrupp med lång erfarenhet. Det finns också ett nära samarbete med enhetens öppenvård, Rådgivningscentrum, gällande ett gemensamt arbetssätt och samordnade insatser.  Vem är du?Vi söker dig som har socionomexamen eller likvärdig utbildning med mångårig erfarenhet och intresse för att arbeta med målgruppen. Du ska ha goda kunskaper inom skadligt bruk och beroende samt gällande lagstiftning enligt SoL/ LVM.Meriterande är:    Erfarenhet av ASI och behandlingsmetoder inom området.    Kunskap om våld i nära relationer och erfarenhet av bedömningsinstrument som FREDA, SARA eller PATRIARK.Du ska kunna arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra. Du är flexibel, stresstålig och har god förmåga att uttrycka dig väl i både tal och skrift.Vi söker en person som är positiv, energisk och som tycker att socialt arbete är roligt. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.ÖvrigtTillsvidareanställning 100% med start 1 april eller enligt överenskommelse. Rekrytering kan komma att påbörjas under ansökningstiden. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!RegisterutdragInför erbjudande av en anställning är du som kandidat skyldig att visa upp ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret vid arbeten inom någon av följande arbetsområden; skola eller förskola, arbete med barn i annan verksamhet än skola och barnomsorg, arbete med barn enligt LSS, arbete på eller i samband med HVB-hem, arbete med äldre eller personer med funktionsnedsättning. Du beställer utdraget via Polisens hemsida. Utdraget ska vara uppvisat innan anställning kan påbörjas. Hur du ansökerLidköpings kommun vill att du skickar din ansökan via vårt rekryteringsverktyg Varbi. Du hittar en knapp längst ner i annonsen där du loggar in och söker tjänsten. Om du av något skäl inte kan söka så (t ex skyddad identitet), vänligen ta kontakt med annonsens kontaktperson för alternativ sökväg.Vi undanber oss samtal från bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av jobbannonser.Undrar du vad som finns att göra och se när du inte jobbar?Lidköping som plats utlovar ett rikt liv, det handlar inte om pengar utan om de möjligheter som finns att leva ett bra liv. Här finns nämligen gott om det som är väsentligt i livet. Bra skolor, trygga områden, ett mångsidigt näringsliv och ett aktivt idrotts- och föreningsliv. Och så förstås ett vackert och sjönära läge vid Vänern.Upptäck mer och fler möjligheter hos Arbetsgivaren Lidköpings kommun. Flytta hit - Lidköpings kommun och Livet i Skaraborg

title: Senior Embedded Software Developer  C/C++ & Automotive Systems - 20784
description: Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry. Job OverviewAssignment DescriptionWe are looking for 1–3 senior embedded software developers to strengthen development teams working on vehicle safety, monitoring and automated driving-related systems.The assignment involves further developing two modules. One handles personnel safety, vehicle-wide monitoring and field generation to detect and respond to obstacles. The other replaces the driver and is based on a third-party product, primarily programmed in Structured Text.Candidates with automotive development experience are preferred. You should be an experienced, self-driven developer who can learn quickly, work effectively in busy teams and adapt to development environments and testing processes that are still being established.What You Will Work On    Develop and enhance embedded software using C/C++.    Work on vehicle safety and monitoring functionality.    Develop obstacle detection and response capabilities.    Contribute to a driver-replacement module using Structured Text.    Collaborate with busy development teams and adapt to evolving development and testing environments.What You Bring    Strong experience in embedded software development.    Good programming skills in C/C++.    Ability to learn new technologies and systems quickly.    Self-driven approach and ability to work independently and in a team.    Flexibility to work in evolving development and testing environments.Meritorious    Experience in automotive or vehicle development.    Experience with Structured Text.    Knowledge of software engineering, testing, electronics systems and communication technology.    Living within reasonable daily commuting distance of the assignment location.

title: Product Owner - E-commerce
description: ​Location: MalmöDepartment: Do It Yourself & E-commerce, Business ApplicationsHiring Manager: Marcus BrattströmThe roleAs Product Owner for E-commerce at Verisure, you will help shape and develop our e-commerce platform together with an experienced, distributed development team. You will connect business needs with technical delivery, create clear priorities and support collaboration between developers, architects, business stakeholders and other technology teams.The role also includes system ownership of Adobe Commerce/Magento, with responsibility for balancing new development with platform maintenance, security, quality and stability. You will join an international environment where collaboration, openness and learning from different perspectives are central to how we work.What you will be up to    Own and prioritise the team’s backlog based on business needs and team capacity    Translate business needs into clear requirements and realistic delivery plans    Coordinate the day-to-day work of a distributed development team    Facilitate planning, refinement, follow-ups and retrospectives    Create alignment with stakeholders around priorities, timelines and dependencies    Act as system owner for Adobe Commerce/Magento    Ensure maintenance, security, incidents and technical improvements are included in planning    Collaborate closely with the AEM team, architects and other dependent teamsGood fit if you have    A couple of years of relevant experience as a Product Owner or in a similar digital product or technical delivery role    Experience owning and prioritising a software or digital product backlog    Experience working closely with distributed development teams    The ability to turn business needs into clear requirements and priorities    Enough technical understanding to discuss integrations, APIs, releases, security and dependencies with technical colleagues    Strong communication and stakeholder collaboration skills    A structured, thoughtful and pragmatic approachNice to have / technologies and areas we work with    E-commerce and digital customer journeys    Adobe Commerce/Magento    Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)    APIs and enterprise integrations    System or application ownership    Technical project management    Platform lifecycle, security and incident management    Jira, Azure DevOps, Scrum or Kanban    Retail, DTC or subscription businessesYou do not need experience in every area. We value curiosity, relevant experience and a willingness to learn.Should I apply?You may enjoy this role if several of these resonate with you:    You enjoy bringing clarity and structure to complex topics    You like connecting people across business and technology    You listen to different perspectives and help turn them into shared priorities    You enjoy working closely with development teams and technical specialists    You are comfortable balancing customer needs with technical quality and long-term platform health    You value collaboration, knowledge sharing and learning from othersFAQ    Do I need Adobe Commerce/Magento experience?No. It is valuable, but experience with another complex digital or e-commerce platform can be equally relevant.    Do I need to be a developer?No. You should be comfortable discussing integrations, APIs, releases, dependencies and technical considerations, but you will work alongside developers and architects who provide deep technical expertise.    Is this a strategic Product Manager role?Not primarily. The role is close to the development team and combines product ownership, delivery coordination and system ownership.    What is the main challenge?Finding the right balance between new functionality, stakeholder needs, security, maintenance and the long-term health of the platform.Bottom lineIf you enjoy connecting people, business and technology, this is an opportunity to take broad ownership of an enterprise e-commerce platform while working closely with an experienced international team.You will help create clear priorities, support effective delivery and contribute to an e-commerce platform that continues to develop in a secure, reliable and sustainable way.About VerisureVerisure is the leading provider of professionally monitored security services in Europe and Latin America. As of 31 December 2025, Verisure provides premium monitored alarm services to a portfolio of ~6.2 million families and small businesses across 18 countries, with a team of more than 30,000 colleagues.For the year ended 31 December 2025, Verisure delivered a strong financial performance: Total Revenue of €3,745 million, Adjusted EBITDA of €1,708 million (46% margin) and Adjusted EBIT of €953 million (25% margin). This performance builds on the Company's track record of resilient, uninterrupted growth over the long term and highlights the strength of its recurring revenue model.Verisure is majority owned by Hellman & Friedman LLC, a leading private equity investment firm.Beginning October 8th, 2025, Verisure is listed on the Nasdaq Stockholm Stock Exchange. With €3.1 billion raised in primary proceeds, this was the largest IPO in Europe since 2022 and the largest in Sweden in over 25 years.My team and I eagerly await your application! Join us on this journey towards a safer, smarter world. Apply today!If you have questions regarding this position, please reach out to our Group Senior TA Specialist, Robert Jonasson, at robert.jonasson@verisure.com.Verisure is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from diverse backgrounds. We are an international company with offices and colleagues in multiple countries.Verisure - 35 years of delivering peace of mind.

title: PE Teacher / Idrottslärare
description: Företagsbeskrivning:Dibber etablerades i Sverige 2017 och bedriver idag förskolor, grundskolor, anpassade grundskolor och öppna förskolor. Dibbers huvudkontor ligger i Sollentuna, verksamhet finns i stora delar av Sverige.Dibber i Sverige är en del av den norska friskolekoncernen Dibber som startades och ägs av två engagerade pedagoger, Randi och Hans Jacob Sundby. Den första förskolan startas 2003 i den lilla stad där Randi växt upp. Idag driver Dibber mer än 600 förskolor i nio länder över hela världen. Vi står upp för livslångt lärande och att hålla oss i framkant inom våra professioner. Vi strävar efter att bygga ett professionellt nätverk där vi lär av varandra och som kan stötta och inspirera. Oavsett vilken del av verksamheten som du arbetar inom, blir du en del av ett team som vill göra en skillnad för barn och elever, och deras framtid. Tillsammans skapar vi en inkluderande arbetsplats präglad av hjärtekultur, lärande och utveckling. Välkommen till Dibber – med hjärta för lärande! Arbetsbeskrivning:Join Our Team: Inspirational Physical Education Teacher (80%) Location: Dibber International School, Norrviken, SollentunaPosition: 80%Start Date: January 2027At Dibber International School, we believe in laying the foundation for lifelong learning, where students grow academically, socially, and personally. Located close to the beautiful Norrviken Lake and with easy access to Stockholm’s pendeltåg, our F–9 school combines the Swedish Lgr22 curriculum with the International Baccalaureate’s pedagogical approach. This gives our students a strong academic foundation together with an international outlook, preparing them to become confident and responsible global citizens.We are now looking for a passionate and committed Physical Education (PE) Teacher (80%) to join our vibrant and forward-thinking team.About the RoleAs a Physical Education teacher at Dibber International School, you will be responsible for planning, delivering, and evaluating engaging PE lessons across our school, from the early years through to Grade 9.As a small school with just one class per grade, you will have the unique opportunity to work with students of different ages, building strong relationships and supporting their physical development throughout their school journey.Teaching is conducted in English, while all teaching and assessment must align with the Swedish national curriculum (Lgr22).In this role, you will:     Plan and teach Physical Education across the school.     Inspire students to develop a lifelong interest in physical activity, health, and well-being.     Adapt teaching to meet the needs, abilities, and developmental stages of students across different age groups.     Assess and support student progress in accordance with the Swedish curriculum (Lgr22).     Create a safe, inclusive, and motivating learning environment where every student feels confident participating.     Collaborate closely with colleagues and contribute to a positive and professional school culture.     Participate in school activities, sports events, and ongoing school development.QualificationsWe are looking for someone who has:     A relevant teaching qualification in Physical Education, preferably with a Swedish teaching licence (lärarlegitimation), or is currently in the process of applying for one.     Strong knowledge and understanding of the Swedish national curriculum (Lgr22) — essential.     Excellent English communication skills, with the ability to confidently teach in English.     Swedish language skills are considered a merit.     Strong planning and organisational skills.     The ability and flexibility to teach students across a wide range of ages and developmental stages.     Experience using digital tools to support teaching and assessment.Personal Qualities:We believe that the right person for this role:     Sees the potential in every student and is passionate about promoting physical activity and healthy lifestyles.     Is enthusiastic, energetic, and able to inspire students of all ages.     Builds strong and positive relationships with students, colleagues, and guardians.     Is proactive, responsible, flexible, and contributes positively to the wider school environment.     Enjoys being part of a small, close-knit school community where collaboration and teamwork are essential.     Values inclusion and ensures that every student feels encouraged and supported, regardless of ability.Why Join Dibber International School?At Dibber International School, you will become part of a warm, professional, and internationally minded school community. We offer:     A beautiful and convenient location in Sollentuna.     A small, welcoming school with one class per grade, allowing you to truly get to know your students.     A dynamic international working environment.     A strong focus on academic achievement, physical well-being, and personal development.     A school culture built on collaboration, innovation, and student-centred learning.     Opportunities for continuous professional growth and development.Would you like to be part of a school where every student is seen, valued, and inspired to reach their full potential? Then we would love to hear from you!Dibber International School Sollentuna:﻿https://www.dibber.se/en/skola/dibber-international-school-sollentuna Profilbeskrivning:Observera att intervjuer sker löpande vilket innebär att tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

title: Förskollärare
description: Vi söker dig som vill vara med och forma morgondagens Ale. Hos oss är du med och levererar service och tjänster av bästa kvalitet till Aleborna. Tillsammans skapar 2 500 medarbetare ett Ale, kommunen som fokuserar på invånarna och deras behov. Bli en av oss!Om arbetsplatsenOlof Persgårdens förskola ligger i trivsamt område i Älvängen med närhet till natur och fina möjligheter till lek, utforskande och lärande. Det finns tre avdelningar på förskolan. ArbetsuppgifterVi söker dig som har ett stort engagemang för barn och undervisning, och särskilt god förmåga att snabbt bygga goda förtroendefulla relationer. Du ska axla ansvaret som ledare för ett arbetslag. KvalifikationerVi söker dig som är legitimerad Förskollärare. Annan utbildning inom ledarskap och pedagogik kan vara meriterande. Uppdraget kräver en stärkt förmåga att snabbt skapa goda relationer med barnen såväl som ett tydligt ledarskap som skapar trygghet och struktur. Denna förmågan behöver kunna stärkas via referenser. Med ett positivt förhållningssätt utgår du från barnens förmåga att utvecklas socialt och kunskapsmässigt och har ett nära samarbete med andra pedagoger på förskolan. Du är en engagerad och positiv lagspelare som kommunicerar tydligt och bygger goda relationer med barn, vårdnadshavare och kollegor. Du är flexibel, initiativrik och lösningsfokuserad, och har alltid barnens utbildning, utveckling och trygghet i fokus.Utöver lärarlegitimation kommer vi att lägga stor vikt vid tidigare relevant erfarenhet samt goda referenser.Om du känner igen dig i beskrivningen och vill vara en del av vårt team skicka in din ansökan idag! ÖvrigtIntervjuer kommer att ske löpande. Giltigt utdrag från belastningsregister ska visas upp, via digital brevlåda via mejl eller till ansvarig rekryterare när ni träffas i slutfasen (utdraget ska vara giltigt 6 månader)Ansökningsblanketten hittar du här:  Registerutdrag för skola och förskola | Polisen Vår värdegrund bygger på att tillsammans tar vi ansvar och skapar förtroende. Vi är måna om att våra medarbetare i Ale mår bra och erbjuder där det är möjligt flexibel arbetstid, friskvårdsbidrag samt förmånliga kollektivavtal. Vill du veta mer om hur det är att arbeta i Ale kommun? Läs mer här: https://ale.se/om-kommunen/jobba-i-ale-kommun.html Tillsammans skapar vi möjligheter, här finns en plats för alla och vi har nära till varandra. Har du skyddade personuppgifter ska du INTE söka via systemet utan kontakta rekryteringsansvarig för hantering av din ansökan.För att underlätta rekryteringsarbetet ber vi dig att bifoga relevanta intyg och betyg för tjänsten du söker samt vid eventuell intervju ha möjlighet att uppvisa giltig ID-handling. Vi har endast möjlighet att ta emot ansökningar via Varbi.Vi strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund. Vill du veta mer om hur det är att arbeta i Ale kommun? Läs mer här: Jobba i Ale kommun | Ale kommunInför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.Vi använder e-rekrytering för att effektivisera och kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsarbetet. Alla dina uppgifter sparas på ditt CV-konto och du kan enkelt logga in och uppdatera dina uppgifter när du vill. Fyll därför i dina uppgifter så omsorgsfullt som möjligt för att ge en rättvisande bild av dig själv. Dina personuppgifter behandlas i Varbi under rekryteringsprocessen och i den utsträckning detta är nödvändigt för att uppfylla lagstiftningen. Ansökan raderas 24 månader efter avslutande av rekrytering. Om du har ett Varbi-konto kan du använda redigeringen av din profil för att radera, ladda upp och redigera information. Kontakta annars Ale kommun.Vi vill upplysa om att din ansökan är en offentlig handling enligt offentlighetsprincipen.

title: In-Room Dining and Breakfast Associate - Sheraton Stockholm Hotel
description: Step into a role that redefines excellence at the Sheraton Stockholm Hotel, a hallmark of hospitality since 1971 in the heart of Sweden's bustling capital. Aligned with our innovative owners, Archer Hotel Management and Marriott International, we merge rich cultural history with modern luxury and a deep dedication to sustainability.   We are now seeking a service-oriented In-Room Dining & Breakfast Associate to join our Food & Beverage team and contribute to delivering exceptional dining experiences for our guests. The primary focus of this role is providing attentive, efficient, and personalized room service, with additional responsibilities supporting breakfast and lunch service. For this role, we are looking for someone who is reliable, guest-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced hotel environment. You take pride in creating memorable guest experiences, enjoy working both independently and as part of a team, and are motivated by providing attentive, high-quality service that exceeds guest expectations. As an In-Room Dining & Breakfast Associate, you will play an important role in ensuring guests enjoy a seamless dining experience in the comfort of their rooms. From handling orders and delivering food and beverages to providing friendly and professional breakfast service, you will help uphold the hotel's standards of quality and hospitality. Main responsibilities:    Handle in-room dining orders, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and a high level of personalized guest service.    Deliver food and beverages to guest rooms promptly and professionally, ensuring an excellent presentation and overall dining experience.    Set up trays and trolleys according to hotel standards, ensuring all orders are complete and presented to a high standard.    Respond to guest requests, dietary requirements, and special preferences with care and attention to detail.    Coordinate closely with the kitchen and Food & Beverage team to ensure timely order preparation and delivery.    Collect used trays, trolleys, and dining equipment from guest rooms and maintain cleanliness in designated areas.    Assist with breakfast service, welcoming guests, answering questions, and ensuring a smooth and enjoyable dining experience.    Maintain the breakfast buffet throughout service, ensuring food items are fresh, replenished, and attractively presented.    Prepare the restaurant for breakfast, including buffet setup, table arrangements, and organizing service stations.    Clear and reset tables efficiently while maintaining a clean and welcoming dining environment.    Assist guests with dietary needs, ingredient questions, and recommendations, and serve coffee, tea, and other beverages as required.    Support lunch service and the transition between service periods when needed.    Maintain hygiene, safety, and food-handling standards at all times. Qualifications:    Able to fluently communicate verbally in English. Fluency in Swedish is a plus.    Previous experience in hospitality or a hotel is an advantage but not required.    Positive attitude and genuine passion for providing excellent guest service.    Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.    Strong teamwork and communication skills.    Comfortable with physical work, including lifting and moving items.In addition:You are a reliable and service-oriented team player who enjoys working in a fast-paced, event-focused environment. What We Offer:    Part time positions following a 6-month probation period, in accordance with the HRF collective agreement.    Chance of being part of one of the biggest renovation and re-positioning projects in Stockholm’s hotel scene.    Great opportunities for career growth.    A dynamic and inclusive work environment.    Employee discounted rates at over 10 000 hotels worldwide. Does this position sound interesting and like a good fit for you? Selection and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the final application deadline, so please submit your application as soon as possible. Join our team and play a key role in creating memorable experiences for our guests!About Sheraton Stockholm HotelThe Sheraton brand, established in 1937, has been synonymous with excellence in hospitality. The Sheraton Stockholm Hotel, opened in 1971 as the first international 5 star hotel in Stockholm, and it’s an icon in Sweden’s capital city. As part of Marriott International, Sheraton Stockholm Hotel is providing guests with thoughtful amenities, contemporary accommodation, and the best city center location. Our commitment to sustainability aligns with our owner Archer Hotel Managements ethos, making us a unique choice for conscientious travelers.Redefining the Essence of HospitalityWe are at the end of our renovation journey at Sheraton Stockholm. This marks the beginning of our mission to redefine the essence of hospitality. We have transformed all our spaces, hotel rooms, implemented new food and beverage concepts and expanded our gym and wellness. As we embark on this transformation, we are seeking the best industry people to join our team.

title: Personlig assistent till kvinna i Gröndal – nära heltid
description: Om Kurera AssistansKurera Assistans är ett ungt och modernt assistansbolag. Företaget är del av Kurera Omsorg som även innefattar Individ- och familj samt Rusta och Matcha. Kurera Assistans har kontor i Malmö, Västervik och Stockholm! För oss är våra medarbetare allt. Utan engagerade, kreativa och hjärtliga kollegor är vi ingenting. Därför tar vi varje rekrytering på största allvar och vill finnas där för vår personal under hela anställningen – med ärliga samtal, närvaro och ett genuint intresse för att alla ska trivas och utvecklas. När våra medarbetare mår bra, mår också våra kunder bra. Vi strävar alltid efter att arbeta med engagemang, ansvar, nytänkande och glädje. Vi vill göra skillnad på riktigt. Hos oss finns kollektivavtal, friskvård och närvarande chefer.  Vi hoppas att du vill bli en del av vårt team!Är du en trygg och omtänksam person som trivs med att arbeta nära andra människor? Vi söker nu en kvinnlig personlig assistent som vill bidra till en fungerande, aktiv och trygg vardag för en kvinna i 50-årsåldern som bor i Gröndal. Det här är en tjänst där din personlighet, ditt engagemang och din förmåga att samarbeta är minst lika viktiga som tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet.Vi tror att du passar hos oss om du har ett varmt och respektfullt bemötande och känner dig trygg i mötet med andra människor. Du är en person som kan behålla lugnet, även när situationer förändras, och som förstår värdet av tydlighet, tålamod och struktur. Vi ser gärna att du är social och positiv, men också lyhörd för när det behövs lugn och ro. Du tar ansvar, kan arbeta självständigt när det behövs och tycker om att samarbeta med kollegor.För tjänsten behöver du även:•    Vara rökfri och inte vara allergisk mot häst eller hund.•    Vara simkunnig.•    Ha mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både muntligt och skriftligt.•    Gärna vara i åldern 35–55 år.•    Se detta som din huvudsakliga sysselsättning.Har du arbetat som personlig assistent tidigare är det ett plus, men det är inget krav. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och söker framför allt någon som har ett genuint intresse för att hjälpa andra. Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats där du får möjlighet att bygga en nära och förtroendefull relation och vara delaktig i att skapa en bra vardag.Som anställd hos oss får du:•    Ett varierande och meningsfullt arbete.•    Kollektivavtal och trygga anställningsvillkor.•    Marknadsmässig lön, tjänstepension och försäkringar samt friskvårdsbidrag.•    En arbetsgivare som värdesätter kvalitet, omtanke och engagemang.I kundens lägenhet finns även ett separat jourrum som används vid nattarbete.Omfattning: Nära heltid, med möjlighet till extrapass.Arbetstider: Varierande arbetstider under dag, kväll och natt, inklusive både aktiv natt och jour. Arbete förekommer på vardagar och helger.Arbetsplats: Gröndal, Stockholm.Tillträde: Snarast möjligt.Vi söker dig som vill ha ett arbete där du får använda både din omtanke och din förmåga att skapa struktur och trygghet. Hos oss blir du en viktig del av en annan människas vardag och av ett arbetslag där samarbete har stor betydelse. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan - vi ser fram emot att höra mer om dig!

title: Financial Controller med erfarenhet av SAP S/4HANA
description: Vi söker en erfaren och analytisk Financial Controller till ett spännande konsultuppdrag i en verksamhet som befinner sig i en större systemförändring. Här får du en central roll i gränslandet mellan Finance/Controlling, verksamheten och ett pågående SAP S/4HANA-projekt. Uppdraget passar dig som trivs nära verksamheten, gillar att kombinera löpande finansiell uppföljning med analys och samtidigt har förståelse för hur ekonomiska strukturer och data behöver fungera i ett nytt system.Till detta uppdrag söker vi efter dig som vill arbeta som konsult via SJR med månadslön samt tjänstepension och övriga villkor enligt kollektivavtal.Om tjänstenI rollen stöttar du verksamheten ur ett finansiellt perspektiv med ansvar för bland annat ekonomisk uppföljning, rapportering, budget och prognos. En viktig del av uppdraget är samtidigt att säkerställa att finansiella strukturer, konton och data förs över och fungerar korrekt i SAP S/4HANA.Du blir en viktig brygga mellan ekonomi, verksamhet och projektorganisationen och bidrar med både din finansiella kompetens och din praktiska erfarenhet av SAP S/4HANA Finance. Rollen är operativ och hands-on, samtidigt som den kräver en god analytisk förmåga och förståelse för helheten.AnsvarsområdenI rollen kommer du bland annat att:- Arbeta med finansiell uppföljning, rapportering samt analys av utfall och KPI:er- Ansvara för delar av budget- och prognosarbetet- Arbeta med investeringar, produktkalkyler och business follow-up- Säkerställa att balans- och resultatkonton samt andra finansiella strukturer hanteras korrekt i det nya systemet- Arbeta med Chart of Accounts, G/L account mapping samt finansiell masterdata- Genomföra avstämningar och kvalitetssäkring av migrerad finansiell data- Stötta verksamheten i frågor kopplade till kostnadsställen, profit centers och ekonomiska strukturer- Bidra i UAT, cutover och vid behov hypercare i samband med implementationen- Samarbeta nära Finance/Controlling, verksamheten samt SAP- och IT-specialisterLämplig bakgrundVi söker dig som har en relevant akademisk utbildning inom ekonomi, redovisning eller finans och flera års erfarenhet inom exempelvis redovisning, controlling eller business control. Du har en stabil förståelse för både balans- och resultaträkning och är van vid att arbeta med finansiell analys och uppföljning.För rollen behöver du ha praktisk erfarenhet av SAP S/4HANA Finance, framför allt FI/CO, samt god förståelse för Chart of Accounts, G/L accounts, kostnadsställen, profit centers och finansiell masterdata. Har du tidigare arbetat i en S/4HANA-implementation, ERP-migrering eller annan större systemförändring är det mycket meriterande. Erfarenhet av UAT, cutover och hypercare är också en fördel.Du har mycket goda kunskaper i Excel och är van vid att analysera, stämma av och kvalitetssäkra större datamängder. Rollen kräver även att du kan kommunicera obehindrat på engelska i både tal och skrift.Personliga egenskaperSom person är du analytisk, strukturerad och noggrann, samtidigt som du har ett pragmatiskt och lösningsorienterat arbetssätt. Du tycker om att sätta dig in i detaljer och identifiera avvikelser, men har också förmågan att förstå hur ekonomi, system och verksamhet hänger ihop.Du är kommunikativ och trivs i en roll med många kontaktytor där du behöver kunna översätta ekonomiska behov och frågeställningar mellan Finance, verksamhet och tekniska SAP-specialister. Du är prestigelös, självgående och bekväm med att arbeta hands-on i en miljö där både processer och system är under förändring.AnsökanFör mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Malin Lindqvist. title: PhD position in biology, specialisation in aquatic ecology
description: Department of Aquatic Resources (SLU Aqua)Third-cycle subject areaBiologyDescription of the doctoral projectA PhD position in biology with specialisation in aquatic ecology is available at the Department of Aquatic Resources at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU Aqua). The theme of the PhD project is on management and conservation methods of critically endangered fishes, focusing on Anguillid eels. Trap and Transport (T&T) is a management method used to enable fish to continue their migration in fragmented riverine systems, and to reduce hydropower turbine mortality for downstream migrating fish. Today, we lack knowledge regarding how T&T should be conducted to optimize the method from an eel’s perspective. The aim of this project is to answer some of these knowledge gaps through field studies, experiments, analysis of existing data, modelling, and via international expert knowledge exchange. The main questions that will be addressed are:     How can the core aspects of the T&T process be optimized from an eel’s perspective?    How is T&T currently conducted in different countries and what can we learn from each other?    In which Swedish watersheds should T&T be prioritized today and in the future?    In addition, the project aims to develop best practice guidelines for T&T to be used at a national and international scale. About the positionThe main task is to conduct the PhD thesis work under supervision, including development of the PhD student's methodological, theoretical, analytical, writing, and presentation skills. The PhD student will conduct experiments in the field, including handling of eels, tagging and more. The work will be done at SLU Aqua in Drottningholm (Stockholm), and at various field sites. The position includes collaboration with international researchers, and one of the co-supervisors is Dr. Derek Evans at the Agri-Food and Bioscience Institute (AFBI), Northern Ireland. The student will also collaborate closely with Dr. Jani Helminen, Natural Resources Institute (LUKE) Finland. RequirementsTo meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39). Specific entry requirements for the third-cycle courses and study programme in biology. To meet the specific entry requirements, you must have at least 90 HEC in biology-related subjects. This must include a degree project, and at least 30 HEC must be at second-cycle level.You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6. Desirable experience    Experience with animal experiments and/or fieldwork.    Experience working with fish.    Experience with relevant practical and statistical methods.    Experience with independent writing.    Experience with organising workshops or large meetings.    Experience with analysis of large datasets.    Experience in collaboration with commercial fishers, industries and management agencies.    Will contribute to a good working climate.    Good communication skills in English, written and spoken.    Driver’s licence.    Great emphasis on personal qualities, collaboration skills, analytical and problem-solving abilities, and capacity for independent work. About usAt the Department of Aquatic Resources (SLU Aqua) we are passionate about conservation and sustainable management of aquatic animals, including fish. We are geographically distributed across Sweden, and this PhD position will be based in Stockholm at the Institute of Freshwater Research, beautifully situated on the countryside on the island of Lovön right by lake Mälaren. We offer:     An excellent and professionally stimulating working environment with dedicated colleagues    Access to a broad international network of scientists    Salary as PhD research fellow in the state salary scale    Good welfare benefits Read more about SLU Aqua: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/aquatic-resources/ Read more about staff benefits and life as an SLU employee: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/ Read more about PhD courses and PhD study programmes: https://www.slu.se/en/study/programmes-courses/doctoral-education/ Form of employment and salary Employment as a doctoral student (4-year programme)Doctoral student’s salaries are set following the local collective agreement. Salary progression is fixed. Scope100% LocationDrottningholm, Stockholm Start date2027-04-01, or upon agreement. Application and selection Please submit your application using the link below. The deadline is 30 November 2027. Applications cannot be submitted through the recruitment system on 20–22 November due to a system update. Read more about the attachments that your application should include at https://www.slu.se/en/study/programmes-courses/doctoral-education/how-can-i-become-a-doctoral-student/application/ Selection among eligible applicants is based on the documents attached to the application, and is carried out with regard to the applicant’s ability to complete the programme within the allotted time. Academic union representativeshttps://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/ Note: This is a shortened version of the advertisement adapted to the Swedish Public Employment Service’s (Platsbanken) system. Please see the full advertisement on SLU’s website: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/jobs-and-vacancies/ The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses.

title: Small Animal Veterinarian with focus on Reproduction
description: Department of Clinical SciencesDo you have clinical experience as a small animal veterinarian, with expertise in reproduction and artificial insemination? An opportunity has arisen to join the Small Animal Department at the University Animal Hospital (UDS), working with reproduction and general veterinary care in a setting closely integrated with research and the teaching of veterinary-and veterinary nursing students. We look forward to receiving your application!About the positionAs a licensed veterinarian at University Animal Hospital, you will work at the Reproduction Clinic. The clinic provides diagnostic services and treatment for diseases of the reproductive organs, optimisation of mating timing, investigation and management of oestrus cycle disorders, fertility assessments, as well as semen collection and cryopreservation and artificial insemination.You will also participate in general veterinary care as part of the varied day-to-day activities at Sweden's only university animal hospital, which operates around the clock.The position includes evening, night and weekend shifts. Our operations run 24 hours a day, seven days a week.You will receive support from our specialists and experienced colleagues in the team, helping you to feel at home in the clinic and develop professionally in your role.As SLU is Sweden's only institution providing higher education for animal health professionals, you will play an active role in educating the veterinarians and veterinary nurses of the future, both in the clinical setting and through other teaching activities in animal reproduction.You will also devote some of your time to reproductive research, with opportunities to apply for your own research funding or participate in other research projects. Our reproductive research is highly active and encompasses all animal species and all aspects of reproduction. The Department has access to advanced laboratory techniques, enabling both in vivo and in vitro studies, and benefits from well-established national and international collaborations.Your profileYou are a licensed veterinarian authorised to practise veterinary medicine in Sweden. You have several years of clinical experience working at a small animal clinic. We would also like you to have experience as a reproduction veterinarian, with the skills required to perform routine procedures such as insemination, semen collection and cryopreservation.As the position involves extensive contact with animal owners and students, you must have a good command of Swedish, both spoken and written, or have a good proficiency in English and be motivated to learn Swedish. The Department will support you in developing your Swedish language skills.At the University Animal Hospital, we are customer-focused and committed to maintaining a professional approach characterised by goodwill and a positive attitude in our relationships with clients and colleagues. You are an effective communicator with the ability to establish and maintain good relationships with both clients and colleagues. You have an interest in teaching and in contributing to an environment that provides good conditions for research. As a veterinarian at the University Animal Hospital, you take a scientific approach to your work and have an interest in evidence-based veterinary medicine. You understand that working in an emergency service, where workloads are driven by unpredictable events and working hours are irregular, requires flexibility and adaptability.As a person, you are well-organised, have good self-awareness and an understanding of what causes you stress, and are motivated to contribute to the organisation. In this recruitment process, great emphasis will be placed on your personal qualities and competencies.About usThe Department of Clinical Sciences is responsible for undergraduate education, research and postgraduate education in the fields of anaesthesiology, diagnostic imaging, veterinary nursing, epidemiology, laboratory animal science, surgery, clinical chemistry, medicine and reproduction. Our activities in all these fields encompass all animal species.At the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU), University Animal Hospital (UDS), education, research and advanced veterinary care go hand in hand. We educate the veterinarians and veterinary nurses of tomorrow and provide high-quality care for companion animals, competition animals and farm animals. We also share knowledge with the wider public. By combining established knowledge with the latest research findings, we are helping to shape the future of veterinary care.Under one roof, we provide veterinary care for horses, dogs, cats and other small animals. In addition to modern facilities specifically designed for our operations, we have access to advanced diagnostic imaging equipment and a specialist veterinary diagnostic laboratory.Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Location:Uppsala, SwedenForm of employment:Indefinite-term employment. title: Engineering Manager - Financial Controlling / Financial Planning & Analysis
employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
description: Job DescriptionJoin H&M Tech and shape the digital backbone of Finance. The role sits within the Finance Area in the Corporate domain, where we combine business expertise and modern technology to build scalable, compliant and efficient solutions for core finance processes. The role is dedicated to one product: Financial Controlling/Financial Planning & Analysis, which enables fast, reliable and transparent financial steering for Controlling, the CFO and CIO Offices, Accounting and Store Management. It covers financial reporting and analytics, daily turnover follow-up, planning and forecasting, and tech finance data, cost transparency and allocation. As Engineering Manager, you will lead the product’s technical delivery and operations. You will partner with the Product Manager, who owns the roadmap, and work closely with Controlling, architecture and engineering teams to turn complex needs into reliable digital solutions. You’ll lead through technology, direction and collaboration, not through direct staff responsibility.  WHAT YOU'LL DO You will lead the product across three delivery teams of H&M engineers, consultants and business experts:     Supporting financial reporting, analytics and daily turnover     Supporting planning, forecasting and investment planning      Supporting Tech Financial – tech finance data, cost transparency and allocation Delivery and roadmap     Lead end-to-end technical delivery, from financial data and reporting to planning and tech cost transparency.     Partner with the Product Manager and Finance stakeholders on roadmap, priorities and releases, bringing technical feasibility and trade-off insights.     Ensure the teams have the right skills, capacity and partners to deliver on agreed priorities.     Own delivery quality across initiatives, continuous improvement (CI) and run, including timely execution of prioritized features and epics.     Ensure solutions are well documented, with AI readability and automation in mind. Operational excellence     Be accountable for the product’s health, monitoring, stability, security and scalability, including incident handling in key periods such as budget and forecast cycles.     Champion data quality and trusted, consistent financial data.     Drive simplification, automation and continuous improvement in line with tech strategy, architecture standards and engineering guardrails.     Follow up delivery and performance KPIs, and proactively manage risks, dependencies and technical debt. Technical leadership     Set technical direction for a landscape that currently combines cloud-native solutions in Microsoft Azure with SaaS platforms such as Anaplan and Apptio.     Uphold engineering standards across architecture, DevOps, CI/CD, security and compliance, balancing delivery speed with technical health and long-term scalability.     Work with solution and enterprise solution architects and lead engineers on solution design, ensuring coherence with adjacent products and the long-term target state. Collaboration, partners and financial accountability     Act as the main tech contact for the product, working closely with the Product Manager, Controlling and other Finance stakeholders.     Collaborate with other tech functions, such as platform, data and AI teams, to solve cross-domain challenges.     Own collaboration with vendors and service providers, including SaaS and managed service contracts, to ensure short- and long-term stability.     Be accountable for the product’s tech costs (budget, actuals and forecast), with a focus on cost efficiency and total cost of ownership.     Share clear updates on status, progress, risks and dependencies. Team and culture     Build a high-performing, inclusive and psychologically safe culture across the teams.     Coach engineers and partners to grow and perform and drive continuous improvement in ways of working and engineering practices.     Plan and contribute to team development together with other Engineering Managers and Competence Managers.  WHO YOU ARE You are an engineering leader who combines technical depth, delivery focus and collaboration. You enjoy working close to the business and know that trusted data and stable solutions come from engineering discipline, learning and simplification.     Experience as a senior software engineer and/or in technical solution leadership, with several years in senior or lead roles leading teams through major deliveries.     Experience leading technical delivery in a product-oriented environment, in close partnership with product and business.     Solid understanding of architecture, scalable design, cloud fundamentals and modern engineering practices such as agile, DevOps and CI/CD.     A DevOps mindset and a track record of building and running stable products, including RUN, delivery, security, monitoring and incident management.     Comfortable with complex business processes, ideally within finance, controlling, planning, reporting, analytics or regulated environments. Experience with data warehousing, BI or planning platforms such as Anaplan is a plus.     Financial acumen and experience managing tech budgets and forecasts, as well as vendors, consultants and SaaS partners.     Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence without formal people management responsibility.     Clear, collaborative and pragmatic — you balance speed, quality, risk and long-term value, and turn complexity into action.     A genuine drive to lead, develop and build strong teams and culture.     Curious about how technology, automation, data and AI can create better experiences and decisions. At H&M Tech, you’ll help build the finance capabilities that keep the business moving, creating solutions that are simple, scalable and ready for what’s next.  WHO WE ARE H&M Group is a global company with strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values.

title: Timanställd personlig assistent sökes till en pojke i Nacka!
description: Vill du arbeta som personlig assistent och bidra till allas lika rätt till ett bra liv?I rollen kommer du göra skillnad i människors vardag och tillsammans med oss arbeta efter Humanas vision – Alla har rätt till ett bra liv.Om tjänstenPersonlig assistans är en insats enligt LSS (Lagen om stöd och Service till vissa funktionshindrade). I din roll som personlig assistent kommer du huvudsakligen att hjälpa kunden med allt som uppstår i vardagen samt med grundläggande behov. Ditt arbete innebär att värna om kundens självbestämmande och integritet, och bidrar till att vardagen fungerar smidigt. Varje assistans är unikt anpassad utifrån kundens liv och därför kan arbetsuppgifter variera beroende på arbetsplatsen.Vår kund är en glad och kärleksfull kille på snart 4 år som behöver stöd i sin vardag. Vi önskar någon som vill vara med och skapa en lekfull vardag med trygghet. Man ger stöd i lek, aktivitet och träning. Man tränar även på att äta med munnen, samt att få mat via peg. Som assistent hjälper du även till med medicinering. Vi ser helst en person som vill arbeta under en längre period då arbetet bygger mycket på den relation man bygger upp med barnet. Personkemi och engagemang väger tyngst.Vem är du?Rollen som personlig assistent ställer höga krav på förmågan att skapa goda relationer. Vi söker därför dig som är lyhörd, engagerad och ansvarstagande. Det är även viktigt att du kan ta egna initiativ och se vad som behöver göras. För att trivas som personlig assistent är det viktigt att det finns bra personkemi mellan dig som assistent och kunden.För tjänsten krävs det att du har:    är lugn trygg lekfull lyhörd och tålmodig    har goda kunskaper i svenska    är djurfri då det förekommer allergi i familen    är rökfri    god fysikFör tjänsten är det meriterande om du:    kompetens inom TAKK och/eller bildstöd    erfarenhet av att jobba med barn.    erfarenhet av barn med speciella behov    erfarenhet av epilepsi    erfarenhet av PEGStor vikt kommer att läggas kring personlig lämplighet.Arbetstid, tjänstgöringsgrad och lön:Aktuell anställningsform är "timanställning" vilket innebär arbete vid behov. Arbetstiderna är förlagda vardagar kl. 15:00-19.00 och helger kl.09:00-18.00.Fast timlön enligt överenskommelse och övriga ersättningar sker enligt kollektivavtal.Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.Vi erbjuderHos Humana är det viktigt att både du som assistent och kunden känner er trygga i samarbetet. Därför får du som ny assistent en introduktion som är anpassad både till yrkesrollen och till den kund du ska arbeta hos. Du får även tillgång till relevanta utbildningar och möjlighet att utvecklas i din roll – så att du har goda förutsättningar att trivas och känna dig trygg i ditt arbete. Humana har kollektivavtal, försäkringar och friskvårdsförmån.Vad händer nu?Vi ser gärna att du ansöker snarast då vi går igenom urvalet löpande och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdagen. Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringssystem i enlighet med GDPR.En förutsättning för att påbörja en anställning hos oss på Humana är att du som söker kan uppvisa giltig ID-handling och eventuella dokument som styrker rätten till arbete inom Sverige. För att kunna jobba som personlig assistent måste du vara minst 18 år.Utifrån lagstiftning krävs att vi som arbetsgivare begär ett registerutdrag från alla anställda som ska arbeta som personlig assistent åt ett barn under 18 år. Därav behöver du uppvisa ett utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister inför en eventuell anställning. Ytterligare information kommer om du går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen.Till dig som arbetar inom rekrytering- och bemanningsföretag samt med annonsförsäljning så undanber vi oss erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringstjänster i samband med den här annonsen.Välkommen med din ansökan!Vill du veta mer om rekryteringsprocessen är du varmt välkommen att kontakta rekryteringsansvarig:Sandra Heras Arvidsson sandra.herasarvidsson@humana.se

title: Postdoctoral Researcher in Plant Stress and Nitrogen Metabolism
description: Department of Forest Ecology and Management Scientific backgroundPlants do more with organic nitrogen than use it for growth. Amino acids and their derivatives can also be diverted into signalling pathways that shape development and help plants respond to environmental stress. We are seeking a motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to investigate how this redirection of organic nitrogen metabolism is regulated and what it means for plant stress tolerance.About the position  The project explores the links between organic nitrogen metabolism, metabolic regulation and downstream signalling cascades, and their roles in plant responses to abiotic and biotic challenges, including pathogen attack. The work will combine physiological, biochemical, molecular and advanced imaging approaches, using Arabidopsis thaliana alongside crop species in sterile, hydroponic and soil-based systems. The position is particularly suitable for a candidate who wishes to build an independent research profile at the interface of plant nutrition, metabolic signalling and stress biologyKey responsibilitiesThe successful candidate will:    Plan and carry out experiments on plant growth, development and stress responses under controlled conditions    Use chemical and genetic approaches to manipulate organic nitrogen metabolism and signalling    Perform gene expression, metabolite and biochemical analyses    Carry out microscopy-based analyses, including confocal and two-photon imaging    Develop and run stress and infection mimicking bioassays as well as nematode assays    Analyse and interpret data, and publish results in international scientific journals    Contribute to experimental planning and take an active part in the group’s national and international collaborations, and in the supervision of studentsYour profileRequired qualifications    PhD in plant biology, plant physiology, molecular biology, biochemistry or a closely related discipline.     Documented experience with experimental plant research, experimental design and data analysis    Documented scientific publishing in international peer-reviewed journals    Ability to plan, execute and document experiments independently    Very good written and spoken EnglishMeritorious qualifications Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered a strong advantage:    Gene expression analysis, particularly qRT-PCR    In vitro sterile culture techniques    Work with Arabidopsis thaliana and crop species    Two-photon microscopy and advanced confocal microscopy    Hydroponic cultivation and soil-based treatments    Mass spectrometry (MS) and metabolite analysis    Phytopathology and plant–pathogen interactions    Bioassay development and implementation, particularly nematode culture and infection assaysGreat importance will be placed on personal qualities such as curiosity, independence, problem-solving ability and the ability to work well with others.As postdoctoral appointments are career-developing positions for junior researchers, we are primarily looking for candidates with a doctoral degree that is three years old at most. If there are special circumstances, such a degree may have been awarded earlier. Special circumstances include leave due to illness, parental leave, positions of trust within trade union organizations, service within the total defence system, or other similar circumstances, as well as clinical service or other employment/assignments relevant to the subject area. About us  The position is based at the Department of Forest Ecology and Management at SLU in Umeå, within the research group led by Professor Torgny Näsholm. The group investigates plant nitrogen nutrition, with a particular focus on the acquisition and utilization of organic nitrogen and their roles in plant physiology and growth. The project will be supervised day to day by Dr Ioanna Antoniadi-Nilsson.The Postdoc. will be employed at The Department of Forest Ecology and Management. The department includes about 120 people of which 9 are professors. Our mission is to advance the understanding of forest ecosystems and how these should be managed today and in the future.For more information: http://www.slu.se/en/departments/forest-ecology-management/Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Umeå is a leading centre for plant science, with a highly collaborative, international research environment and modern facilities for plant growth, imaging and analytics. The candidate will have opportunities to develop an independent scientific profile, gain supervision experience and build an international network.Location:UmeåForm of employment:Temporary employment 36 monthsScope:100%Start date:January 1 2027 or by agreementApplication:Please submit your application before deadline 26 November  2026. You can submit your application by clicking the button below. Applications cannot be submitted through the recruitment system on 20–22 November due to a system update.The application should be written in English and include:    A cover letter (max. 1 page) describing your motivation, research interests and how your experience fits the project    A CV, including a publication list    Copies of relevant degree certificates    Contact details of two or three referees Union representatives:https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/ The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

title: Teamspective: Account Executive (Denmark or Sweden)
description: **Type:** Full-time, permanent**Location:** Helsinki, Copenhagen, Stockholm**Application deadline:** Tue 1.12.2026Join Teamspective, a fast-growing Finnish AI-native SaaS company transforming how organizations lead their people. We're hiring two Account Executives to drive our expansion into Denmark and Sweden!**Your role with us**Teamspective is on a mission to make great leadership a competitive advantage. Our AI-native platform turns employee insights into practical guidance for leaders routines, helping managers lead better every day. With strong growth, proven customer success across the Nordics, and ambitious international plans, we're now ready to accelerate our expansion into Denmark and Sweden.As our **Account Executive for Denmark**, you'll build on our existing customer relationships and strong references, including **Danfoss**, to expand Teamspective's presence in the Danish market. As our **Account Executive for Sweden**, youll focus on opening new opportunities and growing our customer base in a market where were already working with companies like **Hitta.se**. In either role, you'll take ownership of your market and help shape how Teamspective grows internationally.**Your key responsibilities will include:**- Owning the full sales cycle, from prospecting and pipeline building to closing deals, with a focus on mid-sized and large organizations. - Leading discovery meetings and product demos to uncover customer needs and demonstrate Teamspective's value. - Driving B2B sales processes from initial contact to negotiations, procurement, and closing. - Building trusted relationships with HR leaders and other decision-makers through consultative selling. - Developing your market approach and identifying opportunities to scale Teamspective's presence in your country. You'll work closely with our CRO and CEO, existing sales team, and colleagues in customer success and product development, giving you direct access to commercial leadership and the expertise behind our product.Looking further ahead, as Teamspective's presence in your market grows, you could have the opportunity to step into a Country Manager role and build and lead your own local sales team.**Who we're looking for**You're a commercially driven, hands-on sales professional who enjoys opening doors, building relationships, and turning opportunities into results. You know how to engage HR decision-makers and understand what drives their business. You bring strong Danish or Swedish language skills and an understanding of your respective market. Above all, you thrive on taking ownership and are excited to build and grow a market over the long term.**What we expect from you:**- At least 3 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably SaaS, technology, or HR-related - Experience in solution sales to a clearly defined B2B customer segment, with the ability to understand customer challenges and demonstrate business value - A proven track record in new business acquisition and managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing deals - A proactive, independent approach to sales and the drive to build your own pipeline and develop a market - Excellent Danish skills for the Denmark position, or excellent Swedish skills for the Sweden position, alongside good English skills **What we consider a plus:**- Experience selling HR technology solutions or other B2B solutions to HR decision-makers, with an understanding of their business challenges - An established network of HR leaders and decision-makers in Denmark or Sweden - Previous experience opening new markets or developing sales operations in an international growth company **What we offer you:**- Build your market and shape the go-to-market strategy with real ownership. - Sell an AI-native solution that helps organizations turn better leadership into a competitive advantage. - Work alongside experienced leaders and a tight-knit team that moves fast and has your back. - Drive international growth with a proven product, strong customer references, and room to make your mark. - Grow toward a potential Country Manager role and eventually build and lead your own local team. **Practicalities:**These are full-time, permanent positions in which you will be employed directly by Teamspective. You can be based in Helsinki or your respective target market, Copenhagen or Stockholm, after the initial onboarding period. The preferred starting date is as soon as possible in early 2027.**Onboarding:**The role requires you to spend your first 3–6 months working in Helsinki. During this period, you will work closely with Teamspective's commercial, customer success, and product teams, build a deep understanding of the product, and start developing your market from day one. Teamspective will cover accommodation in Helsinki for candidates relocating temporarily. After onboarding, you can work from Helsinki or your respective target country, with regular visits to Helsinki.**Compensation:**The base salary in this position starts from 4000 €/month, complemented by an uncapped commission. As an indicative estimate, on-target earnings (OTE) could range from 90-110 000 euros annually, depending on sales performance. The commission model also includes incentives for qualified meetings during the probationary period. You'll also join Teamspective's employee stock option program after your probationary period. As you grow into a Sales Manager or Country Manager role, there may be opportunities to negotiate a larger equity stake.**Ready to build success in a new market?**Please submit your CV and brief motivation statement by the latest Tue 1st of December 2026 via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/396854/create/.Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

title: 4potentials söker en Vd åt ett företag

Det är ingen hybrid lösning utan du är på plats varje dag mellan cirka 8-18Vi har nedan angett ett antal kompetenser som krav och önskemål. Endast de som uppfyller kraven kommer att kontaktas för den här rollen. Men det går utmärkt att registrera sig i 4potentials databas även för andra framtida Vd-roller. Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Accessibility and Inclusive Design Specialist
description: A partner company is strengthening its team, and Nordic Investin is recruiting an Accessibility and Inclusive Design Specialist. You connect user evidence, service realities and product constraints to create experiences that are clear, inclusive and valuable.The partner is strengthening its capability in inclusive products shaped with disabled and diverse users. You will connect accessibility research, WCAG and assistive technology while ensuring that design reviews and training receive appropriate discipline. The aim is practical progress that colleagues can use, leaders can evaluate and the organisation can sustain.The design function values evidence, critique and collaboration. Success means making complexity understandable and enabling better choices.How you will workYou will work with users, product leaders, engineers and operational colleagues. Design decisions should be tested early and explained through evidence.This role calls for subject-matter depth and practical ownership. You are expected to make trade-offs visible, recognise when a decision needs wider expertise and move work forward without creating unnecessary process.What you will doOwn the practical direction for inclusive products shaped with disabled and diverse users.Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for accessibility research and WCAG.Establish useful standards, routines or decision artefacts around assistive technology.Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting design reviews.Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve training.Strengthen knowledge sharing and sustainable ownership through governance.What you will bringRelevant experience delivering inclusive products shaped with disabled and diverse users in a demanding environment.Strong working knowledge of accessibility research and WCAG.Practical experience applying assistive technology and design reviews.Ability to assess priorities, risks and trade-offs involving training.Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership.Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information.Experience that would add valueExperience from public services banking and large digital platforms.Exposure to governance in a cross-functional or multi-team environment.Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations.A background that can succeed hereYou may come from a product company, agency, consultancy or public service. Your portfolio should explain the problem, contribution, evidence and outcome. Direct experience of inclusive products shaped with disabled and diverse users is valuable, while adjacent experience counts when it shows transferable judgement.What makes the opportunity interestingYou will work on consequential journeys where careful discovery can influence priorities, not simply presentation. The focus on inclusive products shaped with disabled and diverse users gives the opportunity a clear mission and room to influence priorities and success measures.The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision.The recruitment conversationNordic Investin will focus on decisions you have made: the context, alternatives, result and what you would change today. You will also have room to ask direct questions and test whether the role, mandate and partner environment are right for you.How to applyApply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about a relevant product, service or customer journey you helped improve.
