title: Senior HR Business Partner Product and Engineering
description: A partner company is strengthening its team, and Nordic Investin is recruiting a Senior HR Business Partner Product and Engineering. You care about people work that is fair, commercially aware and useful, and you build trust without avoiding difficult decisions.The partner is strengthening its capability in strategic people partnership for product technology and engineering leaders. You will connect workforce planning, organisation design and leadership coaching while ensuring that talent reviews and performance receive appropriate discipline. The aim is practical progress that colleagues can use, leaders can evaluate and the organisation can sustain.The people function combines employee experience, reliable judgement, usable processes and respect for sensitive information.How you will workYou will work with managers, employees and specialist colleagues. The partner values early advice, careful documentation and recommendations people can act on.This role calls for independent judgement and the ability to raise the quality around you. You are expected to make trade-offs visible, recognise when a decision needs wider expertise and move work forward without creating unnecessary process.What you will doOwn the practical direction for strategic people partnership for product technology and engineering leaders.Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for workforce planning and organisation design.Establish useful standards, routines or decision artefacts around leadership coaching.Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting talent reviews.Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve performance.Strengthen knowledge sharing and sustainable ownership through change.What you will bringRelevant experience delivering strategic people partnership for product technology and engineering leaders in a demanding environment.Strong working knowledge of workforce planning and organisation design.Practical experience applying leadership coaching and talent reviews.Ability to assess priorities, risks and trade-offs involving performance.Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership.Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information.Experience that would add valueExperience from digital products engineering and technology services.Exposure to change in a cross-functional or multi-team environment.Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations.A background that can succeed hereYour background may be in-house, advisory, shared services or consulting. What matters is how you owned decisions, balanced needs and improved outcomes. Direct experience of strategic people partnership for product technology and engineering leaders is valuable, while adjacent experience counts when it shows transferable judgement.What makes the opportunity interestingThe role gives you access to meaningful organisational questions and the people who can act on them. The focus on strategic people partnership for product technology and engineering leaders gives the opportunity a clear mission and room to influence priorities and success measures.The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision.The recruitment conversationNordic Investin will focus on decisions you have made: the context, alternatives, result and what you would change today. You will also have room to ask direct questions and test whether the role, mandate and partner environment are right for you.How to applyApply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about a relevant organisation, people service or workforce challenge you helped improve. Nordic Investin welcomes different routes into the profession and assesses evidence, judgement and potential alongside formal titles.

title: People and Culture Manager Growth Company
description: Nordic Investin has been asked to find a People and Culture Manager Growth Company for one of our partner companies. title: Brottsförebyggande samordnare
description: 1 plats(er). Vi söker dig med stort samhällsengagemang och intresse för brottsprevention!Luleå kommun utökar sin organisation kring det brottsförebyggande arbetet och söker en brottsförebyggande samordnare. Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i en nyckelroll där du gör verklig skillnad för tryggheten i kommunen.Om arbetsplatsenTjänsten är placerad på socialförvaltningen som samordnar kommunens brottsförebyggande arbete. Vi erbjuder dig ett utmanande och utvecklande arbete där du får vara med och göra Luleå till en ännu tryggare och säkrare kommun.ArbetsuppgifterSom brottsförebyggande samordnare och teamledare leder, utvecklar och samordnar du kommunens brottsförebyggande och trygghetsskapande insatser. Rollen innebär ett både strategiskt och operativt arbete tillsammans med olika funktioner inom kommunen, andra myndigheter och viktiga samverkanspartners såsom exempelvis polisen.I ditt uppdrag ingår även att ta fram och analysera lägesbilder och åtgärdsplaner, svara på remisser, följa trender och tendenser inom det brottsförebyggande området och hålla dig uppdaterad via nätverk, samarbetspartners och forskning. I uppdraget ingår även att kommunicera kommunens arbete internt och externt. Du kommer vara ett stöd för förvaltningar i arbete kopplat till trygghet och brottsförebyggande samt representera kommunen i olika relevanta nätverk och forum för samverkan.I arbetsuppgifterna ingår bland annat att:    Arbeta med aktuell kartläggning av trygghet och brottslighet.    Sammankalla och bidra till ledningen av arbetsgrupper inom exempelvis samhällsomställningen, BoB-råd och SSPF.    Verkställa och följa upp samverkansöverenskommelsen med polisen.    Leda kommunens arbete med EST (effektiv samordning för trygghet).    Samordning och uppföljning av brottsförebyggande och trygghetsfrämjande åtgärder.    Vara polisens kontaktväg in i kommunen. KvalifikationerVi söker dig som har:    Akademisk examen inom kriminologi, sociologi, statsvetenskap eller annan relevant utbildning.    Erfarenhet av att leda processer och driva arbetet framåt, med eller utan formellt chefsansvar.    God kunskap om samhället i stort.    Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska, både i tal och skrift.Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av liknande arbetsuppgifter och av arbete i politiskt styrd verksamhet.För att trivas i uppdraget behöver du vara trygg i att verka i en komplex samverkansmiljö där både interna och externa parter möts. Du har en god förmåga att bygga, utveckla och upprätthålla relationer och nätverk, såväl internt som externt. Du är samarbetsorienterad, har ett prestigelöst förhållningssätt och förmåga att engagera och motivera andra samt skapa långsiktig framdrift.Som person är du självständig, strukturerad, flexibel och uthållig, med gott omdöme och en hög grad av ansvarstagande. Du har förmåga att planera, organisera och prioritera ditt arbete samt driva det framåt på ett effektivt sätt. Du är strategisk och långsiktig med förmåga att se helhet och sammanhang.Du är analytisk och initiativtagande och trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra. Du har ett starkt samhällsengagemang och ett särskilt intresse för brottsförebyggande arbete. Du trivs i en samordnande och rådgivande funktion och är trygg i att presentera och föra dialog inför olika målgrupper.Tjänsten kommer att säkerhetsprövas.Välkommen med din ansökan – tillsammans gör vi skillnad!ÖvrigtVi är glada över ditt intresse för att bli en del av Luleå kommun. Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i en stimulerande och utvecklande miljö, där vi strävar efter att ge dig en bra medarbetarupplevelse. Du blir en del av en engagerad, kompetent och ansvarstagande organisation som värdesätter dig och din kompetens. Hos oss får du möjlighet att utvecklas och växa i din yrkesroll. Läs mer om våra anställningsförmåner, lönestatistik och vad vi kan erbjuda dig här - https://www.lulea.se/anstallningLuleå kommun är en av Norrbottens största arbetsgivare med en stark framtidstro. Vi arbetar för att skapa en växande och livskraftig kommun med plats för 100 000 invånare. Vårt mål är ett hållbart samhälle med livskvalitet för både dagens och framtidens Luleåbor. Här spelar vi alla en viktig roll - varje dag, året om, för Luleå.Vi strävar efter jämställdhet och ser mångfald som en styrka. Vi välkomnar medarbetare med olika bakgrunder och arbetar för en tillgänglig arbetsmiljö för alla. Luleå kommun ser heltid som en rättighet och deltid som en möjlighet.Att bo i Luleå innebär en balans mellan arbete och fritid. Här kan du njuta av norrländska vintrar, ljusa somrar och en trygg, familjevänlig miljö. I Luleå finns ett rikt kulturliv, friluftsliv och en stark gemenskap med fokus på innovation och hållbarhet.Tips!Vill du flytta till Luleå? www.flyttatilllulea.seNyfiken på andra spännande jobb? www.lulea.se/ledigajobbFölj oss på Luleå kommuns LinkedIn Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.

title: People Business Partner
description: E.ON is one of Europe's largest operators of energy networks and infrastructure and a provider of innovative energy solutions. Our employees are constantly working to digitise the energy world, achieve net zero and connect everyone to good energy. To achieve this, we are focusing our actions on sustainability, digitalisation and growth. We strongly believe that differences make us stronger and welcome all people into our inclusive and diverse culture.Inom E.ON Energiinfrastruktur skapar vi energilösningar som gör skillnad för våra kunder och samhället. Nu välkomnar vi en People Business Partner som vill arbeta nära vår fjärrvärmeverksamhet. Du blir en del av vårt People-team och ingår också i ett större sammanhang med People Business Partners i andra E.ON-bolag och centrala specialistfunktioner. Din rollSom People Business Partner är du en nära partner till chefer och lokala ledningsgrupper och omsätter verksamhetens behov i konkreta HR-insatser. Rollen förenar strategiskt och taktiskt arbete med chefsstöd i vardagen.Du vägleder i frågor som rör organisationsutveckling, förändring, bemanning och kompetensförsörjning. Du stöttar också chefer i arbetsrätt, rehabilitering och komplexa personalärenden samt förbereder och genomför facklig samverkan och MBL-förhandlingar. Tillsammans med chefer och HSE arbetar du för en trygg och hälsosam arbetsmiljö, med fokus på bland annat organisatorisk och social arbetsmiljö och ett hållbart arbetsliv.Tillsammans utvecklar vi arbetssätt och beteenden som stödjer verksamhetens förflyttning. Här får du bidra med perspektiv på hur digitalisering och AI kan förenkla och utveckla People-arbetet.Du utgår från Malmö, Eftersom du stöttar verksamheter i Norrköping, Stockholm och Örebro med chefer på flera orter är resor en naturlig och återkommande del av uppdraget. Dina erfarenheterVi söker dig som har en relevant akademisk utbildning inom HR, beteendevetenskap eller motsvarande och bred erfarenhet av kvalificerat HR-arbete nära chefer och ledningsgrupper. Du har god kunskap om svensk arbetsrätt, kollektivavtal och facklig samverkan samt erfarenhet av rehabilitering och arbetsmiljöfrågor.Du är van vid att stödja förändring och att tillsammans med chefer omsätta verksamhetens behov i prioriteringar och aktiviteter. Du använder gärna HR-data som underlag och känner dig bekväm med digitala HR-system. Du kommunicerar tydligt på svenska och engelska och anpassar ditt stöd efter olika människor och situationer.Du förenar empati och lyhördhet med tydlighet och integritet. Med blicken på helheten tar du självständigt ansvar, bygger förtroende och vågar lyfta svåra frågor. För dig är det naturligt att dela kunskap, stötta andra och känna stolthet över det vi åstadkommer tillsammans. Hur är det hos oss?Hos oss möter du ett hjälpsamt team där vi delar kunskap och stöttar varandra. Du får utrymme att forma ditt arbete och bidra med dina perspektiv, med kollegor nära till hands som bollplank. Din chef Josefina har ett inkluderande och utvecklingsorienterat ledarskap som bygger på tillit, nyfikenhet och tydlig riktning. Hon tror på att de bästa resultaten skapas tillsammans och uppmuntrar till att utforska nya arbetssätt och utvecklas i uppdraget.På E.ON arbetar vi aktivt med inkludering - det är avgörande för att driva energiomställningen framåt. Vi vill att just du ska känna dig välkommen! Vi strävar efter att skapa en trygg arbetsmiljö med meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter och goda möjligheter till utveckling. Vi fortsätter hela tiden att utmana oss själva för att skapa en välkomnande arbetsplats, där vi hoppas att du kommer att trivas.Vi arbetar för ett mer hållbart energisamhälle, men det är minst lika viktigt att våra medarbetare har förutsättningar att värna om sin personliga hållbarhet. Vi erbjuder därför bra förmåner för att du ska må bra och ha god balans mellan arbete och fritid. Några av dessa är arbetstidsförkortning som är högre än branschens standard, hälsoförsäkring, fri sjukvård och mer därtill!Varmt välkommen att söka och var med oss på vägen mot ett mer hållbart samhälle! Sista ansökningsdag är 13 november kl 10.00.Då vi arbetar med samhällsviktig verksamhet är anställningen säkerhetsklassad, vilket innebär att en säkerhetsprövning kommer att genomföras innan anställning.För frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef: Josefina Cederberg Wallin, josefina.cederberg-wallin@eon.se För fackliga frågor, vänligen kontakta:Mats Ekblom, +46 705 259188Akademikerna, Akademikerna@eon.seMattias Andolfsson, Ledarna, mattias.andolfsson@eon.seMats Lundberg, SEKO +46 730 499778

title: Senior Test Lead  Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O | ERP & Enterprise Testing

Reporting & Stakeholder Management    Report test progress, coverage, execution status, and defect trends.    Define and monitor testing KPIs and quality metrics.    Communicate risks, dependencies, and quality status to stakeholders.    Coordinate activities across business, IT, development, and external partners.    Lead and guide testing teams to ensure effective collaboration.6. Release & Go-Live Readiness    Support release planning, test readiness, and cutover rehearsals.    Conduct go-live readiness assessments and provide recommendations.    Ensure test evidence, outstanding defects, approvals, and operational prerequisites are documented.    Support go-live decisions through transparent quality reporting.    Coordinate transition into Hypercare and operational support.Required Skills & Experience    Proven experience leading testing activities in complex IT implementation or transformation projects.    Strong expertise in test strategy, test planning, and test governance.    Experience coordinating functional, integration, end-to-end, SIT, and UAT.    Good understanding of ERP platforms and enterprise business processes.    Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) or comparable ERP solutions.    Knowledge of test case design, execution, coverage, and requirements traceability.    Strong defect management and prioritisation experience.    Experience with test reporting, quality metrics, and risk management.    Experience working in Agile delivery environments.    Ability to coordinate testing across business teams, IT departments, and implementation partners.    Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.    Ability to work independently and take ownership of overall testing activities.Meritorious ExperienceExperience in the following areas will be advantageous:    Annata A365 and industry-specific ERP solutions.    D365 F&O implementation and customisation.    Large-scale ERP transformations and multi-market deployments.    Finance, operations, and business process testing.    Data migration and data quality validation.    Performance and integration testing.    AI-related testing and AI-assisted software delivery.    Test automation and automated regression frameworks.    Cutover planning, go-live coordination, and Hypercare.    Coordination of multiple implementation partners and technology vendors.Who Should Apply?We are looking for a proactive and experienced Test Lead who combines strong testing expertise with excellent leadership and coordination capabilities.The ideal candidate should be able to manage complex testing activities, lead cross-functional teams, and translate business requirements into comprehensive testing strategies.Strong analytical thinking, structured problem-solving, stakeholder communication, and ownership are essential. title: Digital Asset Manager (DAM) Manager
description: Marshall Group is the audio, tech, and design powerhouse uniting musicians and music lovers through genre-breaking innovation. Our flagship brand, Marshall, is uniquely positioned with over 60 years of rock ‘n’ roll attitude on stage, at home, and on the go. Our iconic products are brought to life by a dedicated team of 800 passionate employees and sold in over 90 markets worldwide.What you’ll do:As our Digital Asset Management (DAM) Manager, you’ll play a central role in strengthening Marshall’s global content operations, making sure every digital asset is accessible, accurate and efficiently distributed across all markets and channels. access, permissions, workflows, portals and administrative settings.    Own metadata, taxonomies, naming conventions, asset types and collection structures, and set the standards for tagging, versioning, approvals, publishing, archiving and deletion.    Oversee DAM and PIM synchronisation and support integrations with content management, e-commerce, project management, design and marketing technology systems.    Monitor platform usage, storage, data quality and system health, running regular performance reviews and recommending improvements based on user needs and business priorities.    Manage the relationship with our DAM provider, including support cases, service reviews, roadmap discussions and licence management, and coordinate upgrades, releases and testing with internal technology teams.        Drive the AI agenda for DAM and content operations, identifying and implementing use cases that improve tagging, search, discovery, quality control, localisation and content reuse.    Build workflow automations that reduce repetitive admin, manual handovers and production bottlenecks, and scale new AI-supported ways of working together with creative, marketing, e-commerce, product and technology teams.    Support major campaigns, product launches and content migrations from an asset-readiness perspective, promoting the reuse of approved content to reduce duplicated production.    Define clear roles for asset owners, contributors, approvers and users, and run regular audits on metadata accuracy, asset completeness, rights information and platform hygiene.    Lead onboarding, training and ongoing support for internal teams and external partners, and maintain documentation, governance policies and SOPs.    Establish reporting and dashboards on adoption, search effectiveness, asset reuse and workflow efficiency, and present insights and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.Who we’re looking for:We’re looking for a structured and curious DAM professional who combines strong platform expertise with a background in marketing operations, creative project management or content production. You’re as comfortable working with integrations, APIs and metadata structures as you are understanding the day-to-day needs of marketing, e-commerce and product teams. You turn complex technical requirements into simple, user-friendly processes, you thrive in an international environment and you love finding smarter ways of working. Above all, you’re collaborative and service-minded, with a genuine passion for music and culture.You probably have the following experiences & skills:    Proven experience owning and administering a DAM platform such as Bynder, Adobe Experience Manager Assets, Acquia DAM, Canto or similar.    Hands-on experience with DAM configuration, metadata, taxonomy, permissions, workflows, user administration and governance.    Experience working with a Product Information Management (PIM) platform. Knowledge of Inriver is a strong plus.    A solid understanding of DAM/PIM integrations, APIs, data synchronisation and asset-to-product relationships.    Experience implementing workflow automations (e.g. Figma integrations) or AI-supported content management capabilities.    Experience managing platform vendors, support relationships and performance reviews.    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose platform, process and data-quality issues.    The ability to balance hands-on administration with strategic development and long-term planning.    Experience working with creative, marketing, e-commerce, product and technology stakeholders across multiple countries and cultures.    A structured, detail-oriented approach combined with strong communication, mediation and conflict-resolution skills.Does this sound like you?We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Warehouse Flow Leader (Shift Manager)
description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description: Skiftchefer - DC Fagersta Vill du kombinera operativt ledarskap med möjligheten att utveckla människor, processer och resultat i en verksamhet där säkerhet, kvalitet och leverans står i fokus? Vi söker nu engagerade Skiftchefer till vårt Distribution Center i Fagersta. I den här rollen får du en nyckelposition där du leder ett team på cirka 15 medarbetare och säkerställer att den dagliga verksamheten bedrivs säkert, effektivt och med hög kvalitet. Du och ditt team arbetar enligt skiftgång, vilket innebär att du är en närvarande ledare i den operativa verksamheten och bidrar till att skapa engagemang, struktur och resultat. Bli en del av vårt team Du blir en del av vår utleveransorganisation i Fagersta och arbetar nära andra skiftchefer, stödfunktioner och verksamhetens olika logistikflöden. Här präglas vardagen av samarbete, ansvarstagande och en stark vilja att ständigt förbättra våra arbetssätt. Tillsammans säkerställer vi ett säkert, effektivt och kvalitativt godsflöde som möter både verksamhetens och kundernas höga krav. Ditt uppdrag Som Skiftchef ansvarar du för att leda, utveckla och stödja cirka 15 medarbetare inom ditt skift samtidigt som du säkerställer att verksamheten levererar enligt uppsatta mål för säkerhet, kvalitet och produktivitet. Rollen kombinerar ett tydligt personalansvar med ett närvarande ledarskap där du arbetar nära verksamheten och skapar förutsättningar för både teamets och verksamhetens framgång. I rollen kommer du bland annat att:     Leda och fördela det dagliga arbetet inom Plock & Pack under ditt skift.     Ha personalansvar för cirka 15 medarbetare, inklusive coachning, utvecklingssamtal, uppföljning och kompetensutveckling.     Säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö och att säkerhetsrutiner, processer och standarder efterlevs.     Följa upp verksamhetens resultat genom KPI:er och driva aktiviteter för att nå uppsatta mål.     Delta i och driva förbättringsarbete för att utveckla arbetssätt, effektivitet och kvalitet.     Säkerställa effektiva skiftöverlämningar och god samverkan mellan olika team och funktioner. Din profil Vi söker dig som är en trygg och engagerad ledare med förmåga att skapa struktur, tydlighet och motivation i en operativ miljö. Du trivs med att leda människor i vardagen, är kommunikativ och har en naturlig förmåga att bygga förtroende och skapa goda samarbeten. För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:     Erfarenhet av arbetsledning eller personalansvar inom lager, logistik, produktion eller annan operativ verksamhet.     Förmåga att planera, prioritera och följa upp verksamhetens resultat.     Erfarenhet av att utveckla medarbetare genom coachning och tydligt ledarskap.     Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift.     God systemvana och erfarenhet av att arbeta i digitala verksamhetssystem. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av förändrings- och förbättringsarbete samt kunskap om lager- och logistikprocesser. Eftersom både du och ditt team arbetar enligt skiftgång ser vi att du trivs i en verksamhet som bedrivs över flera skift och uppskattar den dynamik som det innebär. Placering och resor Tjänsten är placerad i Fagersta. Rollen innebär skiftarbete. Resor förekommer i begränsad omfattning vid behov. Ansökan och kontaktinformation Vi uppmuntrar dig att skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida så snart som möjligt, men senast den 6 december 2026. Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. För att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö genomför vi identitetskontroller och drog- och alkoholtester. Vår process är utformad för att vara rättvis och inkluderande; du kan förvänta dig transparent kommunikation och en balanserad utvärdering av dina färdigheter och erfarenheter. I den här rekryteringen genomförs en säkerhetskontroll enligt kraven för Känd avsändare flygfrakt. Läs mer om vad säkerhetsbedömningen innebär på Transportstyrelsens webbplats: Känd avsändare flygfrakt - Transportstyrelsen Vänligen observera att vi på grund av rådande regelverk inte kan hantera ansökningar som skickas in via e-post.

title: Plant Controller
description: Company DescriptionBosch Home Comfort in Tranås develops, manufactures and sells advanced heat pumps that harness energy from nature’s own resources: rock, water and air. Our Tranås site brings together manufacturing, research and development, and business functions, creating an environment where ideas and decisions are closely connected to our products and operations.We believe in technology that makes a difference: Invented for life. Job DescriptionYour contribution to something bigDo you enjoy understanding what really drives performance in a manufacturing business, rather than simply reporting the numbers?As our Plant Controller, you will work at the intersection of finance and manufacturing, partnering closely with Plant Management and colleagues across production, logistics, engineering and other functions.You will turn financial and operational data into insights that support better decisions, stronger performance and continuous improvement. This is a hands-on controlling role where you can build a broad understanding of our manufacturing operation and have a real impact on how we manage costs, investments and performance.Your key responsibilities    Business partnering: Act as a financial partner to Plant Management and cost center owners. Provide analysis, challenge assumptions and translate financial performance into clear insights and actions.    Planning & forecasting: Drive key parts of our business planning, budgeting and forecasting processes, including cost centers, Capex, production volumes, headcount and product costs.    Manufacturing performance: Analyze manufacturing costs, productivity and operational deviations. Work with the organization to understand root causes and identify appropriate countermeasures.    Product costing: Lead Planned Product Cost (PPC) calculations, follow Actual Product Costs (APC) and analyze the operational and financial drivers behind deviations.    Investments, assets & inventory: Support investment planning and follow-up, fixed asset management, inventory valuation, physical stocktaking and continuous inventory control.    Reporting & continuous improvement: Drive monthly and annual plant performance reporting while continuously improving our processes, reporting, dashboards and use of SAP and other digital tools.QualificationsWhat distinguishes youYou have a degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Industrial Engineering and Management, or a comparable field, together with experience in controlling, financial analysis or a related finance role.Experience from manufacturing or another industrial environment is particularly valuable.We are looking for someone with:    Strong analytical skills and confidence working with financial and operational data    Experience with budgeting, forecasting, cost accounting or operational reporting    Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel    Experience working with ERP systems. SAP experience, particularly within controlling or manufacturing processes, is an advantage    Professional working proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Swedish is an advantage, but not a requirementExperience with product costing, Power BI, automation or other data-analysis tools is an advantage, but you do not need to tick every box. We value your ability to learn, understand the business and turn data into meaningful insights.Who you areYou are curious about the business behind the numbers. When you see a deviation, your instinct is not simply to report it. You want to understand why it happened, what is driving it and what we can do about it.You are comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions and collaborating across functions to find solutions. You can explain financial concepts clearly to colleagues outside Finance and combine strong analytical thinking with a practical mindset.You take ownership of your work, build strong relationships and are motivated by understanding how a manufacturing business works and how Finance can help make it better.Additional InformationWhy join us in Tranås?In Tranås, more than 600 associates work across manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a more sustainable future.For a Plant Controller, this creates an exciting environment where you can see the connection between the numbers, the decisions and what actually happens in the factory.The role gives you broad exposure to manufacturing finance, product costing, investments and operational performance, while working within the international Bosch organization. It is an opportunity to deepen your controlling expertise, influence the business and continue developing your career.At Bosch, we value openness, trust and different perspectives, and we want our associates to have opportunities to grow both professionally and personally.What we offer    Competitive compensation    Pension, insurance and other benefits in accordance with our collective agreement    Flexible working hours and hybrid working possibilities where compatible with the role    Employee discounts on Bosch products    Development opportunities within an international Bosch organizationRegular presence at our Tranås site is an important part of the role because of the close collaboration with our manufacturing organization.If you enjoy combining finance, manufacturing and problem-solving, we would like to hear from you.

title: Head of Business IT Support Services till Saab Aeronautics

Experience from ITSM, support operations, asset management, business applications or international IT operations is valuable. You are a relationship-oriented leader with strong business understanding and a clear service mindset. You are comfortable leading through others, driving change and creating collaboration across organizational boundaries. You have the ability to translate business needs into practical IT services and solutions and to work effectively across the interface between local business requirements and enterprise-wide IT capabilities. This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around security protection. For positions requiring security clearance, additional obligations regarding citizenship may apply. What you will be part of Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters. title: Small Animal Veterinarian with focus on Reproduction
description: Department of Clinical SciencesDo you have clinical experience as a small animal veterinarian, with expertise in reproduction and artificial insemination? The Department has access to advanced laboratory techniques, enabling both in vivo and in vitro studies, and benefits from well-established national and international collaborations.Your profileYou are a licensed veterinarian authorised to practise veterinary medicine in Sweden. title: Postdoctoral Researcher in Plant Stress and Nitrogen Metabolism
description: Department of Forest Ecology and Management Scientific backgroundPlants do more with organic nitrogen than use it for growth. Amino acids and their derivatives can also be diverted into signalling pathways that shape development and help plants respond to environmental stress. We are seeking a motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to investigate how this redirection of organic nitrogen metabolism is regulated and what it means for plant stress tolerance.About the position  The project explores the links between organic nitrogen metabolism, metabolic regulation and downstream signalling cascades, and their roles in plant responses to abiotic and biotic challenges, including pathogen attack. The work will combine physiological, biochemical, molecular and advanced imaging approaches, using Arabidopsis thaliana alongside crop species in sterile, hydroponic and soil-based systems. The position is particularly suitable for a candidate who wishes to build an independent research profile at the interface of plant nutrition, metabolic signalling and stress biologyKey responsibilitiesThe successful candidate will:    Plan and carry out experiments on plant growth, development and stress responses under controlled conditions    Use chemical and genetic approaches to manipulate organic nitrogen metabolism and signalling    Perform gene expression, metabolite and biochemical analyses    Carry out microscopy-based analyses, including confocal and two-photon imaging    Develop and run stress and infection mimicking bioassays as well as nematode assays    Analyse and interpret data, and publish results in international scientific journals    Contribute to experimental planning and take an active part in the group’s national and international collaborations, and in the supervision of studentsYour profileRequired qualifications    PhD in plant biology, plant physiology, molecular biology, biochemistry or a closely related discipline.     Documented experience with experimental plant research, experimental design and data analysis    Documented scientific publishing in international peer-reviewed journals    Ability to plan, execute and document experiments independently    Very good written and spoken EnglishMeritorious qualifications Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered a strong advantage:    Gene expression analysis, particularly qRT-PCR    In vitro sterile culture techniques    Work with Arabidopsis thaliana and crop species    Two-photon microscopy and advanced confocal microscopy    Hydroponic cultivation and soil-based treatments    Mass spectrometry (MS) and metabolite analysis    Phytopathology and plant–pathogen interactions    Bioassay development and implementation, particularly nematode culture and infection assaysGreat importance will be placed on personal qualities such as curiosity, independence, problem-solving ability and the ability to work well with others.As postdoctoral appointments are career-developing positions for junior researchers, we are primarily looking for candidates with a doctoral degree that is three years old at most. If there are special circumstances, such a degree may have been awarded earlier. Special circumstances include leave due to illness, parental leave, positions of trust within trade union organizations, service within the total defence system, or other similar circumstances, as well as clinical service or other employment/assignments relevant to the subject area. About us  The position is based at the Department of Forest Ecology and Management at SLU in Umeå, within the research group led by Professor Torgny Näsholm. The group investigates plant nitrogen nutrition, with a particular focus on the acquisition and utilization of organic nitrogen and their roles in plant physiology and growth. The project will be supervised day to day by Dr Ioanna Antoniadi-Nilsson.The Postdoc. will be employed at The Department of Forest Ecology and Management. The department includes about 120 people of which 9 are professors. Our mission is to advance the understanding of forest ecosystems and how these should be managed today and in the future.For more information: http://www.slu.se/en/departments/forest-ecology-management/Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Umeå is a leading centre for plant science, with a highly collaborative, international research environment and modern facilities for plant growth, imaging and analytics. The candidate will have opportunities to develop an independent scientific profile, gain supervision experience and build an international network.Location:UmeåForm of employment:Temporary employment 36 monthsScope:100%Start date:January 1 2027 or by agreementApplication:Please submit your application before deadline 26 November  2026. This is position within Epiroc's Global/Regional Distribution Center, where you will play an important role in ensuring reliable and efficient deliveries to customers around the world. You will be part of an international team and collaborate with colleagues, customers, freight forwarders, and customs partners across multiple regions. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a supportive and fast-evolving environment where digital tools, systems, and business processes are continuously being developed and improved. Your Mission As an Order Fulfillment Export Coordinator, you will be responsible for managing the flow of customer orders from receipt to delivery, helping to ensure a seamless customer experience. In this role, you will coordinate customer orders and provide support to Customer Centers and Distribution Centers. You will handle export administration and trade documentation, oversee invoicing and shipping activities, and monitor deliveries to ensure they arrive on time. You will work closely with freight forwarders, customs brokers, warehouse teams, and internal stakeholders to maintain efficient operations and ensure compliance with export control, customs, and trade regulations. Each team member supports a designated portfolio of Customer Centers and Distribution Centers worldwide and serves as their main point of contact, building strong relationships and contributing to excellent service.Profile description:Your Profile We believe you bring a combination of expertise, curiosity, and a collaborative approach to your work. You likely have a university degree in logistics, supply chain management, business administration, economics, or a related field. Or have developed equivalent knowledge and skills through extensive relevant work experience. Experience within international logistics, export operations, customer order management or supply chain activities will help you succeed in this position. Knowledge of trade compliance, customs procedures, and Letters of Credit is valuable, as is experience working with M3 and Oracle Transportation Management (OTM). You are comfortable working with different IT systems and enjoy learning new tools and processes. You communicate fluently in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing. You have a structured and detail-oriented way of working, while maintaining a strong customer focus. You enjoy solving problems, identifying improvements, and collaborating with others to achieve shared goals. You are comfortable managing several priorities at the same time and adapt well to change in a dynamic environment. Most importantly, you are a team player who values cooperation, builds positive relationships, and contributes to a supportive and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. Application and Contacts The position is based in Örebro, Sweden. Application and contactsPlease send your application, including CV and personal letter, by creating an account in our recruitment system as soon as possible but no later than 25th of November. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date. Please note that, due to the current regulations, we will only consider applications received through our system and not via email or social media.

title: Head of Product Management
description: Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters.Your roleWe are looking for a Head of Product Management for our new Product Unit Command, Control & Autonomy. The new product unit within Business Unit Naval Combat Systems, develops the next generation of Naval Command, Control & Autonomy systems, built on a modern software stack and serving as the foundation for Saab's future naval capabilities. The product unit is driving the transition towards software-defined, modular and upgradeable products that support advanced naval platforms while enabling future autonomous capabilities and Multi-Domain Operations.As Head of Product Management, you will lead and develop a team of Product Managers responsible for key parts of the product portfolio. Your mission is to define the overall product vision, strategy and portfolio direction, ensuring alignment between customer needs, business priorities and technology evolution. Working closely with Development, Marketing & Sales and customers, you will establish the frameworks, priorities and strategic direction that enable Product Managers to successfully develop and evolve their respective product areas.As a member of the product unit Management Team, you will help shape the future of software-defined naval capabilities, ensuring that our Command, Control & Autonomy portfolio remains at the forefront of technology, customer value and operational effectiveness. At the same time, you will play a key role in building a world-class Product Management capability within the product unit.Key responsibilities:    Lead, coach and develop a high-performing Product Management organization.    Own the overall product vision, strategy and portfolio roadmap.    Drive portfolio prioritization, investment decisions and lifecycle management.    Ensure alignment between customer value, business goals and technology strategy.    Support Product Managers in defining and executing product roadmaps.    Identify future customers and market needs and translate them into strategic product initiatives.    Drive the transition towards software-defined, modular and AI-enabled products.    Build a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.    Work closely with Development, Marketing & Sales and customers.    Contribute to the strategic development of product unit Command, Control & Autonomy.Your profileTo be successful in this role, you are an authentic and modern leader who believes that empowered teams, clear direction and strong collaboration are key to building successful products. You are passionate about developing people and creating an environment where Product Managers can take ownership, grow and succeed. At the same time, you provide the strategic direction and portfolio perspective needed to align product investments with customer needs and business objectives.You lead through vision, values and objectives rather than detailed control, and you are comfortable navigating a complex stakeholder landscape while building trust across the organization.We believe you have:    Proven experience in Product Management, Product Strategy or Business Development.    The ability to lead through influence, create alignment across stakeholders and drive strategic product decisions.    Experience developing product strategies and product roadmaps in a technology-intensive environment.    A strong track record of driving growth, innovation and customer value.    Experience from software-intensive and high-tech environments.    An understanding of modern software engineering practices, AI-enabled development and digital transformation.    Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.    The ability to create clarity, alignment and direction across a complex product portfolio.    A collaborative leadership style focused on developing people, teams and organizational capabilities.Experience from defence, naval systems, autonomy, AI, Multi-Domain Operations or other safety-critical industries is considered an advantage.This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.What you will be a part ofExplore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters. Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world. Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here.Kindly observe that this is an ongoing recruitment process and that the position might be filled before the closing date of the advertisement.

title: MCN Technical Support Strategic Driver | Early Career Program
description: Company description:Ericsson ABJob description:   About this opportunity   Ericsson’s Early Career Program is an 18-month journey for you who are recently graduated or have up to five years of relevant experience. Through three rotations, including one international and market exposure, you will tackle challenges that matter, work alongside people who expect you to contribute, question, and move things forward.    The Innovate track is designed for you who are driven by building what’s next. You’ll rotate across Research, Product Development, Data, and AI contributing to solutions that don’t just support the business but move it forward.    This isn’t a program where you sit on the sidelines. From day one, you’re hired into a role, trusted to contribute, supported to grow, and expected to make an impact. Find out more about the Early Career program here.    Your journey in the Innovate program will start as an MCN Technical Support Strategic Driver, supporting Mission Critical Networks (MCN) and Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) in safety-critical contexts. You will help teams deliver dependable support for customers such as defence organizations and government agencies.      What you will do    You will help ensure that mission-critical network projects are supported from early planning through deployment and live operation. This includes integrated sensing and communication (ISAC)—technology that allows a wireless network to provide connectivity and also detect or monitor objects and activity in its environment. In safety-critical settings, dependable service and clear support arrangements are essential.         Connect pre-sales and deployment teams with RAN software and hardware support teams, using your view of the radio portfolio to help set clear expectations and move from product-by-product support to coordinated, end-to-end support.     Define practical support processes, case triage, escalation routes and clear responsibilities across radio, transport, core network, applications, customer operations, system integrators and third-party partners, bringing structure and operational leadership to cross-functional ways of working.     Coordinate proactively with design, solution, customer, project and operations teams so support needs and responsibilities are clear and considered early in project planning.     Join early studies, proofs of concept and pilot projects. Use lab environments to validate support approaches, reproduce faults and test complete solutions.     Identify gaps in skills, tools, infrastructure and security practices; develop training and practical troubleshooting guides; and share lessons from customer cases to improve future solutions.     Participate in live support cases, identify recurring issues, track readiness and performance, and recommend improvements.       You will bring    We provide a platform for you to contribute to technology and services that matter in safety-critical situations.  Bring initiative: ask questions, take responsibility for your work, and collaborate across teams to turn support needs into clear actions.      In addition you have        MSc or BSc in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent, with 3–5 years of relevant experience.     Ability to structure complex problems, take initiative, define ways of working and prioritize actions; project-planning experience is helpful but can be developed on the job.     Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the confidence to work across organizational, technical and cultural boundaries and drive change.     Curiosity to explore emerging MCN/ISAC use cases, learn quickly and adapt in a changing environment, with a proactive, action-oriented mindset.     Working knowledge of RAN software and hardware, the radio portfolio, wireless communication and network architecture; familiarity with mission-critical communications is an advantage.     Experience in technical support, troubleshooting or deployment of complex network solutions; experience with labs, PoCs or security considerations is an advantage.     Strong stakeholder coordination, communication and analytical skills, with proficiency in English and an ability to lead operational work across teams.   Pre-offer checks including references and relevant background screening will be conducted for final candidates.

description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Informaticien système et réseau (H/F), 100%. --- Informaticien système et réseau (H/F), 100%. ============================================== ### Introduction Au cœur des Alpes vaudoises, les stations de Villars, Gryon et des Diablerets sont reliées pour former un domaine skiable d'exception : plus de 100 km de pistes, plus de 280 enneigeurs et des paysages grandioses à chaque virage. Derrière chaque passage de portique, chaque caisse, chaque webcam ou chaque plan des pistes consulté sur un téléphone, il y a un réseau qui fonctionne. C'est cette fiabilité, discrète mais essentielle, qui permet à nos hôtes de profiter pleinement de leur journée. Pour garder notre domaine connecté et accompagner son évolution technologique, nous recherchons notre futur \*\*Informaticien système et réseau (H/F), 100%\*\*. En bureau comme en altitude, vous êtes le point de contact de nos collaborateurs pour tout ce qui touche à l'informatique, et vous n'hésitez pas à mettre la main à la pâte lorsqu'il faut installer du matériel sur place. ### Responsabilités \* Assurer le support de niveau 1 et 2 : prise en charge des demandes, diagnostic et résolution des incidents, escalade et suivi auprès des prestataires externes ; \* Installer, configurer et maintenir les postes de travail, périphériques, caméras, équipements mobiles et la téléphonie ; \* Intervenir sur le terrain pour réparer, entretenir ou mettre à jour l'infrastructure IT sur les différents sites, notamment en altitude ; \* Participer à l'exploitation de l'infrastructure IT : serveurs, réseaux, sauvegardes ; \* Assurer le suivi de nos systèmes métier : billetterie et vente de forfaits, terminaux de paiement, contrôle d'accès, webcams et écrans d'information ; connaissance de l'environnement Skidata un atout; \* Administrer l'environnement Microsoft 365; \* Participer aux projets informatiques et à l'amélioration continue du service, en lien avec les différents métiers, et sous la supervision du responsable IT; \* Rédiger et tenir à jour la documentation : base de connaissances, procédures, instructions de travail. ### Qualifications Vous disposez d'une formation en informatique ou une formation équivalente en systèmes et réseaux. Nous recherchons une personne polyvalente, fiable avec un bon esprit d'équipe et le sens du service aux utilisateurs. \* Expérience réussie dans un premier poste similaire et solides connaissances en informatique : environnements Microsoft, systèmes Windows, réseaux, infrastructure et périphériques ; \* Esprit pratique, orienté solution, à l'aise avec le câblage et l'installation de matériel, en extérieur et par tous les temps ; \* Des notions dans le domaine électrique (courant faible, raccordements, alimentation des équipements) constituent un atout ; \* Disponible certains week\\-ends en saison ; \* Permis de conduire, à l'aise à ski ou en snowboard. ### Avantages \* Un cadre de travail unique dans les Alpes vaudoises \* Une équipe engagée et dynamique \* Des projets variés et innovants \* Des possibilités de formation continue Ainsi que : \* Carte remontées mécaniques Suisse (RMS) \* Avantages partenaires TVGD \* Événements d'entreprise \* Facilités de transport ### Candidature Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre dossier complet d'ici le 30 novembre prochain. description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Senior Software Engineer Backend (Mandatsaufträge)--- Senior Software Engineer Backend (Mandatsaufträge)===================================================### We invent. Mit Substanz. Gute Software entsteht nicht zufällig. Sie entsteht durch Weitsicht, technisches Können und echte Zusammenarbeit. Seit über 25 Jahren entwickeln wir nachhaltige IT\-Lösungen mit offenen Technologien und einem klaren Anspruch an Qualität. Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt unserer Arbeit liegt im Mobilitätsumfeld und im öffentlichen Sektor. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen entwickeln wir Lösungen, die täglich von vielen Menschen genutzt werden und einen gesellschaftlichen Mehrwert stiften. Dabei setzen wir auf langfristige Partnerschaften und begleiten unsere Kund:innen oft über viele Jahre hinweg im Rahmen von Mandaten. So kannst du Lösungen nicht nur mitentwickeln, sondern massgeblich und nachhaltig prägen.  ### You contribute – Das bringst du mit * Java\-Expertise: Du bewegst dich absolut sicher im Java\-Ökosystem und hast über viele Jahre bereits etliche komplexe Backend\-Lösungen mit Boot realisiert.* Architektur\-Mindset: Du durchdringst komplexe Systeme mühelos und bringst ein tiefes Verständnis für moderne Backend\-Architekturen mit.* KI\-Mindset: Du bringst eine natürliche Vertrautheit mit modernen KI\-Tools und Coding\-Assistants mit und bist interessiert an neuen Workflows wie dem Agentic Coding.* Macher:in \& Teamplayer: Du arbeitest gerne eigenverantwortlich, blühst aber erst im interdisziplinären Team so richtig auf.* Nah am Kunden: Freude an der langfristigen Zusammenarbeit mit Kund:innen in agilen Teams – vorausgesetzt sind dafür sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse. Idealerweise bringst du eine Ausbildung in Informatik (Uni, FH oder HF) mit. Von Vorteil sind Erfahrungen mit Frontend\-Technologien wie Angular oder React sowie Kenntnisse in Quarkus, PostgreSQL, Kafka und containerisierten Umgebungen mit Docker oder Kubernetes. Eine Affinität zur Mobilität rundet dein Profil ab. ### You invent – Das lernst und entwickelst du bei uns * Architektur \& Code: Du treibst die Weiter\- und Neuentwicklung moderner Backend\-Lösungen voran und prägst technische Konzepte sowie Systemarchitekturen aktiv mit.* Qualität aus Überzeugung: Du lebst Clean Code und sicherst die Softwarequalität durch Reviews, automatisiertes Testing und gezielten Einsatz von KI\-Tools zu.* Interdisziplinärer Teamspirit: Du arbeitest eng mit Kolleg:innen in interdisziplinären, agilen Teams zusammen um ganzheitliche Produkte zu schaffen.* Kundennähe: Du berätst unsere Kund:innen auf Augenhöhe bei technischen Fragestellungen und unterstützt sie im Rahmen von Mandaten nachhaltig und langfristig – von der Idee bis zum Support des produktiven Systems.* Wissens\-Hub: Als Senior teilst du dein Wissen im Team und unterstützt jüngere Entwickler:innen in ihrer Entwicklung. ### We care – Das erwartet dich bei uns* Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und echte Mitverantwortung* Langfristige Kundenbeziehungen und Projekte mit Substanz* Flexible Arbeitszeiten und gute Sozialleistungen* Ein unkompliziertes, kollaboratives Umfeld* Arbeitsort vor Ort in Bern, remote work bedingt möglich ### BewerbungWir sind unkompliziert und mögen den direkten Kontakt zu dir. Deshalb akzeptieren wir keine Bewerbungen von Stellenvermittler:innen. Through its Basketball For Good and Cultural Heritage activities, it uses the power of basketball to create positive social change and preserve and promote the sport's heritage. We are looking for a Communications \\\& Partnerships Senior Associate to coordinate the Foundation's internal and external communications and support its partnership and fundraising activities. The position will have a strong communications focus, while helping to connect the Foundation's storytelling and content with donor engagement and revenue generation. \*\*Position Overview\*\* The Communications \\\& Partnerships Senior Associate is responsible for increasing the visibility, awareness and impact of the FIBA Foundation through compelling storytelling, effective stakeholder communications and donor\\-focused content. The role contributes to strengthening the Foundation's reputation, engagement and fundraising efforts through integrated communications and partnership support. \*\*Communications\*\* \* Coordinate the implementation of the FIBA Foundation's communications strategy and related budget with the Head of the Foundation's website, social media channels, newsletters and other digital communications. \* Monitor website and social media performance to recommend actions to improve audience reach and engagement and identify new audience engagement and growth opportunities. \* Identify and produce news, stories, interviews, case studies and other content covering Basketball For Good, Cultural Heritage and the Foundation's wider activities. \* Coordinate communications campaigns, publications, presentations and promotional materials. \* Liaise with Foundation colleagues, FIBA departments, project partners and other stakeholders to identify relevant content and communication opportunities. \* Coordinate external freelancers and suppliers supporting editorial content, social media, design, photography and video. \* Monitor communications activities and provide regular reporting on reach and engagement. \* Develop communications KPIs and recommend improvements based on performance analysis. \*\*Partnerships and fundraising communications\*\* \* Work with the Head of Foundation, Foundation colleagues and the appointed fundraising agency to ensure communications support the Foundation's partnership and fundraising priorities. \* Develop compelling impact stories and other content for donor proposals, presentations, partnership materials and fundraising campaigns. \* Support donor and partner communications, recognition and stewardship activities. \* Participate in à la fonction ou expérience jugée équivalente.  * Expérience avérée de 5 ans dans un poste similaire impliquant une gestion d’équipe et formation en management (atout).  * Leadership, prise de title: Senior Clinical Scientist
description: Roche Switzerland bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are located here. For our long\-term client, F. Hoffmann\-La Roche AG in Basel, we are looking for a**Senior Clinical Scientist****Background:**In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life\-changing innovation at speed.Neuroscience \& Rare Diseases (NRD), we are committed to realizing the vision of the Roche One Pharma Strategy in Neurology to preserve and restore what makes people who they are. Our research and early development activities center around large and rare indications within four major therapeutic network areas: Dementias, Multiple Sclerosis, Movement Disorders, and Neuromuscular \& Neurodevelopmental Disorders. With strengths across diverse disciplines, Roche is uniquely positioned to lead in transforming science to medicines for patients with disorders of the nervous system.**Tasks \& Responsibilities:*** Your activities will include the development and writing of study documentation including protocols, informed consent forms, clinical study reports, as well as clinical science input for study\-specific operational and regulatory documents.* You will be responsible for ongoing monitoring of clinical activities and study conduct, coordination of data collection, data review, analysis, and interpretation as well as preparation and presentation of results for informed decision\-making.* You will be the main point of contact for data management regarding periodic clinical data review and data cleaning* You will participate in study management, as clinical science representative, to ensure trial deliverables are met according to timelines, budget, quality standards and operational procedures, within a global multidisciplinary cross\-functional Study Management Team (SMT)* You will provide training and science input to operation colleagues and study site staff, as agreed with clinical operations* You will monitor study progress on a regular basis to identify any problems or issues that could affect the results or completion of the study; you will investigate and employ problem\-solving strategies.* You should bring a positive, energetic, responsible, creative, curious and solution\-seeking mindset and proactively contribute to interdisciplinary clinical project teams with integrity, passion and courage.**Must Haves:*** PhD or Masters with extensive work experience as a clinical scientists* 5\+ years the clinical scientist role in different neurological indications, preference for Multiple Sclerosis and Alzheimer’s Disease* You possess strong analytical and quantitative skills, with a proven track record in clinical data review, analysis, and reporting data.* You have a solid understanding of clinical development processes (phase 2\-3\), study design principles, and international clinical research and safety guidelines.* You are a collaborative, solution\-oriented scientist who communicates effectively across teams, values diverse perspectives, and makes sound, independent decisions.* You have excellent written, oral communication, and presentation skills.* Fluency in English**Nice to Have:*** Veeva**What you will be offered:*** An opportunity to work in one of the world's most important pharmaceutical companies* Modern campus with plenty of green spaces and meeting areas* Central location in Basel* Varied job profile* Further training opportunities through temptraining* Working in a dynamic and motivated teamIf you are interested please send your application documents addressed to Ms Marianne Buser.Basel\-Stadt Neuroscience Clinical Trial Management Data Analysis Reporting clinical scientists Clinical Developmentj4id10478384jm j4it1146jm j4iy26jm

title: Senior Legal Officer
description: Join MSF OCG as Senior Legal Officer! We are looking for passionate people who are ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission. Find out below the details of the position and the qualifications we are looking for. Inclusion and Diversity at MSF Your qualifications and experience do not exactly match all the requirements? At MSF OCG, we are committed to fostering an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff. We strive to create working environments where teams of people with varied backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF’s social mission and improve outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with. We understand that some people may hesitate to apply if they do not meet all the requirements of the position. Research shows that this is particularly true for women. If you believe your profile is a good fit for this position, we encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet all the qualifications listed. We welcome applications from people of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, origins, religions, beliefs, disabilities and any other diversity characteristics. MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation or abuse, or any form of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will be subject to reference checks. Context & Mission  Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent international medical humanitarian organisation that delivers care to people in need, to people affected by natural or man-made disasters and to victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and irrespective of race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter). The MSF movement is organised around five operational centres, supported by 24 sections and offices around the world. The Operational Centre Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centres. The Senior Legal Officer is part of the Public Fundraising unit, one of the four units of the Fundraising Division within the Communication and Fundraising Department of MSF Switzerland. Reporting to the Legacies Coordinator, they handle the administrative and legal management of legacy and inheritance files, provide legal expertise and help optimise the follow-up of these files, in close collaboration with the Legacies Officers. Main responsibilities  Manage and follow up the administrative and legal aspects of legacy and inheritance files, in French and German, in collaboration with the Legacies Coordinator and in tandem with the Legacies Officer. Contribute to optimising the management of donations, legacies and inheritances, ensuring that all legacies and inheritances intended for MSF Switzerland are actually received and processed optimally and securely. Apply the processes and procedures relating to estates, in particular regarding the acceptance of inheritances and court decisions, while protecting the interests and reputation of MSF Switzerland. Act as legal point of reference for complex files, provide expertise and advice to the team and take responsibility for the quality of file processing, including in the event of errors. Support the Legacies Coordinator with some of their tasks and work with the various external partners, in particular notaries, lawyers, executors and public authorities. Develop, maintain and strengthen relationships with current and potential testators in French- and German-speaking Switzerland, in particular through first contacts, visits, phone calls and events, ensuring regular follow-up with this target audience. Enter and update information in the database, in particular for new estate files, people interested in legacies and inheritances, and ongoing files. Handle the financial follow-up of files in collaboration with the Legacies Coordinator and the MSF Switzerland finance department, in particular in the context of estate administration and the preparation of annual provisions for the files under their responsibility. Profile Education University degree or equivalent training in law, or very good knowledge of inheritance law. Experience Previous experience in a similar role. Previous experience with MSF or another NGO or international organisation is an asset. Technical skills Strong attention to detail. Excellent IT skills, including internet research and office software. Knowledge of the Swiss legal and political system, in particular inheritance law. Analytical skills and comfortable working with figures. Ability to express oneself and argue with ease, both orally and in writing. Languages Bilingual French-German (mandatory). Fluent written and spoken English.  Knowledge of Italian is an asset. Personal qualities Ability to meet deadlines. Very good stress resistance. Independent, enthusiastic, dedicated and motivated, solution-oriented and able to integrate easily into a team. Ability to adapt to varied and unforeseen situations with flexibility and agility. Ability to manage one’s own work without continuous supervision. Proactive, able to take initiative and put forward new proposals to solve identified problems or improve a situation. Flexibility and ability to work in a multicultural environment. Interest in, understanding of and commitment to humanitarian principles and MSF’s values. Ability to identify urgencies and priorities. Ability to meet deadlines. Flexibility and ability to work in a multicultural environment. Interest in, understanding of and commitment to humanitarian principles and MSF’s values. Working conditions Part-time position (90%): 36 hours per week Permanent contract Place of work: Zurich Ideal start date: March 2027. Gross annual salary (at 100%): CHF 94,440 to CHF 108,348 (depending on equivalent experience and the internal salary scale). Paid holidays: 25 days per year, pro rata temporis, plus Swiss public holidays falling within the contract period. Pension fund: contributions to the pension fund (2nd pillar, LPP/BVG) covered 3/4 by MSF and 1/4 by the employee. Relocation support when moving to Switzerland from another country. How to apply Candidates are invited to submit their application exclusively via our recruitment platform, in line with the following requirements. CV (maximum 2 pages) Cover letter (maximum 1 page) Documents must be written in French or English. The application deadline is 22 November 2026. Please note that we reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier if we receive a sufficient number of qualified applications. Applications will be treated confidentially. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. We do not wish to use the services of recruitment or placement agencies

It’s a good start. Apply.**About the Function**The Compliance Department protects the Bank against money laundering, fraud and sanctions breaches, and oversees the Bank's adherence to its regulatory obligations through controls, monitoring and supervision. The Client Lifecycle Integrity (CLI) department runs the operational processes that keep client records complete and up to date, from account opening to client data updates and closures. Both departments rely on accurate data and efficient workflows, and work closely with IT and Data Governance.  **Description**As Compliance Data \& Automation Engineer, part of the Support and Sanctions team and embedded in the Compliance Department, you will support the Compliance and Client Lifecycle Integrity (CLI) departments by simplifying access to data, automating processes and contributing to the development of AI into the tasks of the Compliance and Client Lifecycle Integrity departments. For the Compliance Department, you will help strengthen control and supervision activities with automated checks, AI\-assisted tools and reliable reporting. For CLI, you will help to automate operational workflows to reduce repetitive tasks and improve processing quality.You will collaborate with Swissquote's technical teams on strategic workflow, automation and AI initiatives as well as all other relevant teams.Your tasks will include:* **Process streamlining and automation**: Leverage your programming expertise and AI knowledge to enhance internal systems, automate processes for Compliance and CLI and add some AI into the Departments’ day to day work.* **Data Stewardship**: Support data governance by ensuring consistent data definitions, monitoring data quality, and implementing data\-related decisions tools.* **Reporting** **\& Regulatory Support****:** Contribute to the automation of internal and external processes and reporting.* **Compliance Analysis:** Conduct data\-driven compliance analysis to support decision\-making.* **Ad\-hoc Projects:** Participate in transversal projects in collaboration with various stakeholders within the bank. **Key Responsibilities**Compliance – Control \& Supervision:* Analyse compliance control processes, identify automation opportunities and develop solutions through , JavaScript and workflow automation tools* Design, build and deploy AI\-assisted tools (LLMs, RAG, agents) to support alert review, investigations, adverse media screening and regulatory research* Automate controls and supervision reporting, giving Compliance management a clear view of alerts, cases, pipelines and control results* Ensure AI solutions are explainable, auditable and compliant with data privacy requirements.* Translate Compliance requirements into technical specifications for IT development or improvement initiativesClient Lifecycle Integrity – Operational Automation:* Map CLI operational processes and identify manual, repetitive tasks suitable for automation* Build and maintain automated workflows for client data processing, document handling and data updates, using AI where it adds value (e.g., document extraction and classification)* Monitor the performance of automated workflows and continuously improve processing time and quality* Train and support CLI and Compliance staff in the adoption of AI and automated workflowsData Stewardship:* Maintain and enhance the Compliance Data Dictionary, ensuring business definitions, standards and metadata are aligned with enterprise data governance policies* Define, enforce and measure data quality rules; operate data quality monitoring processes, document risks and support resolution efforts* Ensure that the Data Owner's decisions are effectively implemented in day\-to\-day data operations* Act as Single Point of Contact for Compliance data matters, coordinating with BRM and other data stakeholders across the bankReporting \& Regulatory Support:* Perform and manage complex data extractions from structured databases using SQL and other query tools* Provide accurate, timely and auditable data extracts for regulatory requests, internal audits and external inspections* Automate and optimize recurring extraction and reporting processes* Proactively monitor regulatory changes impacting data needs, including those related to the use of AI * Master's degree in a Quantitative field, Engineering, Computer Science or Data Science* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in data, automation or AI knowledge of SQL to query and extract data from structured databases* Knowledgeable in JavaScript, HTML and CSS for web development (React, or Django)* Understanding of Compliance framework and/or solid appetite to learn Compliance and Risk topics within a Swiss bank* Familiarity with data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, FINMA, ...)* Fluent in French and English**Preferred Skills*** Experience
